clean_body: Hi folks! I just made it official: I‘m running for U.S. Senate! Folks - my name is Michele Tafoya. I made a career as a sideline reporter for some of the biggest moments in sports history. I spent many Sunday evenings out on the gridiron. And I've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? I never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... - STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares - DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents - ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports - OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants - FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool's errand. After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. But blazing my own trail has never scared me. I made history on TV and won four Emmys for my sports coverage. I've taken on longer odds than this - and I beat them. I'm taking on Tim Walz's inner circle, the DC power brokers, and the political class who have sold us out for too long. Luckily, there are a lot more of us than there are of them! Now that I have made my decision, my path to winning this Senate race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents. That last part is important - because if we can't get our message out far and wide, this race is over and the far-Left wins. | | ---|--- This just became one of the biggest Senate races in the entire country. I mean it. I'm already hearing that the career politicians are terrified of my campaign. They're scared because 120+ million people saw a viral video showcasing rampant fraud happening under Tim Walz's watch. They're scared because folks know who I am and they know I don't take BS from anyone - not from players on the field and certainly not from some empty suits in DC. And they're scared because they know that if the American people have to choose between fraud, incompetence, special interests, and powerful party bosses... And honesty, common sense, and plain talk - the political class is in for a reckoning. Are you with me? I can't do this without you! Thanks for taking the time to read this email! Together, we're going to make history - I can feel it in my bones. Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! This morning, the U.S. Supreme Court heard a case that could change everything
for girls’ and women’s sports – including right here in New Hampshire.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/girls-sports-scotus-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260114_girls-sports-scotus-email_sb?&utm_medium=JST&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260121_girls-sports-scotus-email_indirect>
If the Court sides with the Left, girls could lose their spots, their
scholarships, and any hope of fair competition.

As a former girls’ basketball coach and, more importantly, as a dad, this hits
close to home.

<https://secure.winred.com/scott-brown-for-new-hampshire-inc/girls-sports-scotus-email-acs/?recurring=true&utm_medium=pemail&utm_source=rs_acs&utm_campaign=20260114_girls-sports-scotus-email_sb?&utm_medium=JST&utm_source=rcl&utm_campaign=20260121_girls-sports-scotus-email_indirect>
I coached my daughter’s team. I watched those girls push themselves, support
each other, and give everything they had on the court. They earned every win,
and they played by the rules.

But now, the Left is trying to rewrite the rules and erase fairness for girls
like my daughter. And they’re using the courts to do it.

That’s one of the many reasons I’m running for U.S. Senate.

New Hampshire needs someone who won’t be afraid to tell the truth. Who won’t
bend to the woke mob. Who will fight like hell for fairness, biology, and
common sense.

But I can’t do this alone. This race is already one of the most competitive
in the country. National Democrats are pouring in millions to defend this seat
and keep another strong conservative voice out of the Senate.

If we’re going to flip this seat and keep the Senate, I need a grassroots team
behind me. Can I count on you to chip in $10, $25, or whatever you can today to
help us fight back and WIN, Friend?

TAKE A STAND

This campaign isn’t about me. It’s about protecting opportunity, protecting
our daughters, and protecting the values we believe in.

Let’s build a team that fights as my girls did with heart, grit, and

Thank you for standing with me,

Control over every transaction you make. Vance has warned Americans this could let Washington decide what you can buy, how much you can shield, even freeze your money with the push of a button. Trump has called a Digital Dollar a dangerous threat to freedom. And now, through FedNow, Washington has found a way to implement it in practice. body:
The Justice Department is going after Trump’s enemies list.

Peter, I just got off the phone with Governor Walz.
He, Attorney General Keith Ellison, and Mayor Jacob Frey of Minneapolis are facing an investigation from Donald Trump’s Department of Justice for “obstruction of justice.”
And they’re asking this team directly for our help: [**Please make a contribution to the Democratic Governors Association, which is leading the legal defense of this fight.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kdh-fftp-dgalf?refcode=em260121&refcode2=915_2563979_-rQbPR&akid=915%2E2563979%2E-rQbPR)
The Justice Department is going after Trump’s enemies list. He ran on a campaign of revenge and retribution, and now he is attempting to deliver on that threat.

It sets a dangerous precedent that undermines public trust in our institutions and distracts from the real issue at hand: ICE agents shot and killed Renee Good.

name: Anika Page
subject: Dispatch from the Dome: The Bill Deadline Has Passed—Here’s What Matters Now
body:
View this email in your browser (https://mailchi.mp/mspolicy/dome-dispatch-12851548?e=5703353baa)
Good morning Friend,

If you’ve been following along the past couple of weeks, you know things have been moving fast at the Capitol. This week marked an important turning point in the legislative session: the deadline for introducing new bills has officially passed.

That deadline matters more than it might sound. Up until now, lawmakers have been focused on filing ideas. From here on out, the focus shifts to debating, amending, and voting on the bills that actually made it in before the clock ran out. While hundreds of bills were filed before the deadline, history tells us that only a small number will ultimately advance and become law.

In other words, the session is moving from volume to substance — and that’s when the real decisions begin.

Below is a look at where things stand, with updates from both chambers, a closer look at education reform, and a notable win for conservative governance and responsible budgeting.

** The Bill Deadline — Why This Moment Matters
------------------------------------------------------------

For a bill to become law, it first has to pass committee and then receive a floor vote in its originating chamber. If it passes there, then the process repeats in the other chamber before the bill is sent to the Governor.

Over the past two weeks, the Legislature introduced hundreds of bills across both chambers. Now that the filing deadline is behind us, lawmakers have to start narrowing their focus to the proposals that are still alive and moving through committee.

This is often the point in session where priorities become clearer. Some ideas gain momentum, others quietly stall, and attention begins to center on the bills that have a real path forward.

** What’s Happening in the House
------------------------------------------------------------

With bill introductions wrapped up, the House is beginning to shift gears. Committees are starting to sort through the large volume of legislation that was filed, and the emphasis is now on which bills will actually move to the floor.

Education policy has remained one of the most active areas in the House so far, with HB 2 emerging early as a major focus. Beyond education, House members have filed legislation touching healthcare regulation, state spending, and a variety of local issues. Many of those proposals are now waiting for committee consideration as the House works through its priorities.

The next few weeks will tell us a lot about which of these ideas have the support to move forward.

** A Senate Update — And a Clear Conservative Win
------------------------------------------------------------

The Senate has moved more quickly into floor action, particularly on government structure and budget-related reforms.

This week, the Senate voted unanimously to pass SB 2017, a bill that eliminates 22 obsolete state boards and commissions — entities that no longer serve an active or necessary purpose.

This is a straightforward example of conservative governance in action. Clearing out boards and commissions that exist only on paper helps streamline state government, reduce unnecessary bureaucracy, and cut structures that cost taxpayers money without delivering results.

At a time when Mississippians are rightly focused on responsible spending, SB 2017 is a reminder that reform doesn’t always require new programs — sometimes it means finally letting go of old ones.

Credit is due to Lieutenant Governor Delbert Hosemann for prioritizing this legislation, and to Senator Tyler McCaughn for authoring SB 2017. This bill represents a shared commitment to leaner, more efficient government.

** Education Reform Update: HB 2 Moves Forward
------------------------------------------------------------

Education reform continues to be a central conversation at the Capitol, and HB 2, the Mississippi Educational Freedom Program Act, remains one of the most closely watched bills this session.

Last week, the House Education Committee took up HB 2 and voted to advance the bill by a 14–11 vote, sending it to the full House for consideration. Later that week, the House debated the bill on the floor, where it passed by a narrow 60–58 vote.

The close margin underscores just how significant — and closely watched — this legislation has become. With House passage complete, HB 2 now heads to the Senate, where it will receive further consideration in the weeks ahead.

Lawmakers have also made adjustments along the way. Notably, provisions related to teacher and assistant teacher pay are being separated into standalone legislation. That change allows education pay raises to be debated and voted on independently, rather than being tied to the broader school choice debate.

HB 2 would allow parents greater flexibility to direct their child's share of state education funding toward the learning environment that best fits their needs.

** Certificate of Need: Incremental Movement, Limited Reform
------------------------------------------------------------

Certificate of Need reform remains an important priority, and while we would prefer broader repeal of Mississippi’s CON laws, the Legislature is currently considering more limited, targeted changes.

One bill to watch is HB 3, which revises certain Certificate of Need provisions and increases the dollar thresholds that trigger CON requirements. The bill also creates specific exemptions and directs further study of potential reforms related to dialysis units and psychiatric care.

While HB 3 does not represent comprehensive CON reform, it reflects continued legislative willingness to revisit how healthcare access and competition are regulated in Mississippi. We’ll continue to evaluate which proposals meaningfully move the state toward greater flexibility and improved patient access—and which fall short of that goal.

Supporters argue that easing these restrictions could increase competition and expand access to care, particularly in underserved areas.

** What I’ll Be Watching Next
------------------------------------------------------------

With the bill deadline behind us, attention now turns to floor votes, committee deadlines, and which reforms ultimately make it to the Governor’s desk.

I’ll continue tracking education reform, healthcare regulation — including ongoing conversations around Certificate of Need — and efforts to make state government leaner, more efficient, and more accountable.

I'm also watching early conversations around restoring Mississippi's citizen-led ballot initiative process, an issue that could resurface later in session.

** Track Legislation in Real Time
------------------------------------------------------------

Want to follow along as bills move through the process? You can track key legislation throughout the session using the Mississippi Center for Public Policy’s bill tracker.
Track Bills at the Capitol (https://mspolicy.org/bill-tracker/)
Thanks for taking the time to stay informed and engaged. I’ll be back next week with another update from under the dome — and as always, I’ll keep breaking things down in plain language as session continues.

Until next time,

Anika Page
Director of Operations

name: John Hickenlooper
subject: some bad news, some good news
body:
Democrats have a difficult road ahead if we're going to take back the Senate in 2026, and the fact is, there's no path for us to win the majority without defending Colorado.
| [](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4421?t=2&akid=382%2E124072%2EhEG7Gk) I have to share some bad news with you: **Democrats have a difficult road ahead if we're going to take back the Senate in 2026, and the fact is, there's no path for us to win the majority without defending Colorado.** Just let that sink in for a moment, folks. **If we lose this seat, there goes our best chance of rebuilding our Democratic Senate majority to halt Trump and Republicans’ extreme agenda and continue making progress for working people** — like expanding access to health care, keeping jobs here in America, tackling the sky-high cost of living, _and more_. Now here’s the good news. **I’ve got one heck of a card up my sleeve: an incredible grassroots team.** Look, National Republicans have been eyeing this seat ever since we won in 2020 and flipped Colorado blue. But this seat has a history of flipping back and forth, so we can’t afford to get complacent and let the GOP tighten its grip on Congress. **Peter, that means it’s going to take all of us working together to keep this seat blue and help Democrats take back the Senate in 2026.[If you’re up for that fight, please, take a moment to split a donation between my campaign and Roy Cooper and help us prepare for the long road ahead. →](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4421?t=3&akid=382%2E124072%2EhEG7Gk)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately and be split between John Hickenlooper and Roy Cooper:_ | [SPLIT $5](https://act.roycooper.com/go/4422?t=4&akid=382%2E124072%2EhEG7Gk)

| | Patriot,
---
| | Charlie would have wanted you to have this.

Before his September 10th assassination, Charlie had just put the finishing touches on a very important book. His final book.

The topic is one that Charlie found to be crucial for every human to understand and practice.

This isn't a book about public policy or political discourse, nor is it simply about passing on values of patriotism to young Americans.

**Instead, this book is about something far deeper and more personal -- the importance of honoring the Sabbath and resting in God's grace. **

Despite his hectic schedule and full life, Charlie was committed to setting aside an entire day each week to rest, to pray, and to give undivided attention to God, Erika, and his children.

By honoring the Sabbath, Charlie lived out a powerful message: _**" God, You are enough. And because You are enough, I need not carry the weight of a world that was never mine to hold." **_

His book, _**Stop, in the Name of God**_ is the fruit of that conviction.
---
[](http://links.g4yamerica.com/u/click?_t=cc7dda5c2cc64061900678c88bd3a18a&_m=6b22126758b74f84bb6fb43ca6a6f68a&_e=28krEL2MPSPBGn58cRwDSYDTdGLpKq2akfrRXs3dPC362SafOs15NaNjkw8QfrNEVzjIJOs7UEiLiO7zIGj9NGkv99av8YXbDnSI93sjgX2buc9TYZSxgt4TJ-l4s06wEHonAtmYeKjnTQbnRrM_mm8OqXSya1qPZaEGH37AGylPUxQH7ogz-sx-Z9R3tX4YTq-ksn-DC7PVHCgD6KodQ7g1qj_l_Rd-mK2KfW6pSQn_e4o10xZEanTxW2Nt-zdk6ler63-0LzWkNNGcrukreOhei6QAKJ_J4H4xW4DdxHEsq2jSXe-wIUfxKz0OI8JfVvuZqEg3PGsbBAQQxHaBuhNxBvoZ1lYDjNNASJGxbiiTPXugwSvWu1obPUU1Oi3gpnYfqehQWNuCwNwHpu-z4hx47n01arkk1vgXpGchw0uoMEwPeHZgM8uB0zb-uUPTx1S5ysrMjyHRpbXPYERnC2sm8FKLqnApFgXZBvdoQ79L6kKnXNMv2VeFboWCi9XW-bR7H9WSAPKdYbrblGOOodLhdBbJmbu4Xady8Eo2cAlkjVuxcl9WC-xO9jRpVzQ3DvdZz8HHVeH--V2iwWsg1CK_fYlNo7eIpognP2gdOLXUbEOMX7IgjtFuUx2rk7ZKeDCc6FrGUyqtUqel4cth7-C2yq9gICwUCca4QynOsHYw6kF_-9voRihvZglhwK-X)

When you read it, you will hear Charlie's voice inviting you to reclaim something our fast-paced culture has essentially erased: a time for rest, a time devoted to God, and time with family.

Charlie's hope was for each of us to rediscover the Sabbath as he did: not as a burden to bear, but as a gift to receive...

A sacred routine meant to draw us nearer to God, to steady our hearts with His peace, and renew our strength for the battles to which He calls us.

I believe you will find this book inspiring.

Charlie wanted everyone to have this book because its message meant so much in his own life.

In the months since Charlie's assassination, there has been a massive surge of interest in Turning Point USA's message among young Americans...

...and it's not just the conservative message as a whole -- _**it 's the message of FAITH! **_

In recent months, I have heard countless stories of people who have answered Charlie's call to attend a Bible study, start a family, and pray to God.

Charlie devoted so much of his time urging people to build strong families, to go to church, and to stand up for America. _And it 's happening. _

After years of witnessing declining church attendance, we are now seeing Americans filling the pews in huge numbers across the country.

What we're witnessing is not just growth --**it 's revival. **

At Turning Point USA, we are dedicated and honored to continue strengthening the faith of Americans, young and old.

We are building a coalition of truth-preaching churches that stand firm against cultural compromise, defend biblical values, and strengthen families.

We are training pastors, uniting congregations, and, of course, reaching the next generation on campuses across the country with this same message.

You might feel disheartened by the evil in our culture and by the unthinkable assassination of Charlie.

**But America 's faithful are waking up. The youth are waking up. America is waking up. **

All across this nation, pastors are linking arms, young believers are finding their voice, and families are saying, _" We're not backing down." _

This is what Charlie prayed for.

I see this book as one of Charlie's most enduring gifts to the world, and I know you will too.

None of us knew how brief his time on earth would be. But the truths written in this book are timeless. They will outlive us all, and most importantly, **_so will the legacy of Charlie 's faith. _**

Charlie lived life at a relentless pace, but he also understood the sacred value of stillness. Through it all, his gaze was fixed on eternity with God.

name: Tom Leonard
subject: The Positive Path Newsletter
body:
[](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/TfdxTxSHSOkIRM2hYohvVw/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw)
---
Dear Friend,
---
This past week has been a busy one on the campaign trail, and I justwant to highlight some of the key moments:

• I attended and spoke at data center meetings in the local communities of Mason and Greenwood Township.

• On Wednesday, we released our first major digital ad campaign. Check out "[Is Your Family Fed Up?" here](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/P1fflTj8hA763MMoWEe1uVGQ/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw)!

• On Saturday, I had a chance to talk with young Republicans from Saginaw County over Zoom.

• On Sunday, I attended 180 Church in Detroit and had the privilege of listening to my friend, pastor Lorenzo Sewell, give his sermon.

Our team is more fired up than ever heading into the rest of January. With real solutions already on the table, we're building momentum one conversation at a time.

This is what winning looks like - showing up, listening, and fighting for you!

**Better Schools Start with Parents in Charge**

Michigan's education system ranks among the bottom ten in the nation and last in the Midwest. This is a crisis. I'm committed to real reform that puts parents in charge, focuses on results, and prepares every child for success.

We Must:

• Confront the Literacy Crisis Head-On -- Adopt proven "Mississippi Miracle" reforms: universal literacy screening for K-3 students, teacher training in the science of phonics, early high-quality tutoring and interventions, and holding students back from 4th grade only after they meet reading benchmarks--with strong supports and full parent involvement every step.

• Protect & Expand School Choice -- Empower parents to choose the best path for their child, including charters, virtual schools,
homeschooling, and education savings accounts, so families, not bureaucrats, decide what's right.

• Keep Indoctrination Out of Classrooms -- Prevent the State Board of Education from mandating gender identity lessons; give parents the right to opt out of any content they view as inappropriate or indoctrinating, and ensure sex education is never required for graduation.

• Protect Parental Rights on Major Decisions -- Make it a crime for school employees to assist or encourage a student in changing their gender identity without explicit parental consent. Decisions about a child's identity belong to parents, not schools.

We will also be hosting another Virtual Education Town Hall on January 24th with Nikki Snyder, and Aley Minton joining.

We'd love to have you be a part of it. RSVP with the information on the flyer below!
---
Together, we will improve our education system and put power back in the hands of parents. This is The Path Forward.

**Next-Gen Spotlight**

Our Next-Gen Spotlight for this week is **Rebecca Yager**.
---
"Tom is a candidate that shows that he means what he says...He's the candidate I feel is going to fight the hardest for my future by listening to our experiences and what we need to succeed in the Great Lakes State." \- Rebecca Yager

Rebecca is a senior at Delta College and will be graduating with a degree in Manufacturing and Industrial Technology/Computer-Aided Design.

Volunteers like Rebecca make this campaign successful.

Thank you for all your time and support, Rebecca!

**Join the Team!**

Much like Rebecca, you can help spread the message of our campaign all across the state! It's with your help that results come. We would love to have you join the team!

Volunteer Today: Sign up for phone banking, door-knocking, events, or hosting a meet-and-greet in your community. Your time makes all the difference! [Sign Up Here](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/IZY6NGBpq1lnwrjvLudvvQ/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw) And reach out to our Field Director, Tony, for more volunteer opportunities at tony@tomformichigan.com

Continue sharing our positive vision on social media - follow my X account's, [@Tom4Michigan](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/KiB763b7VkaebQ2ipESJ8YSg/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw) and [@TomLeonard28](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/3zSKqCxdNyDqGfow9jZTIw/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw), my [Facebook page](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/FEGB36SMUelYWRm7qBsThw/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw), and my [Instagram](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/QI5ECgNeq8AyHd6MpIRuXg/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw).

Thank you for continuing this fight with us week after week.

Together, we are building The Path Forward for Michigan.

God bless you and your loved ones. Have a great week.

Best,

Tom Leonard
Candidate for Governor

To learn more, get involved, and donate visit [www.TomForMichigan.com](https://sendy.right-strategies.us/l/cve9YluPeAoOO3uAO6KV4g/FGfM1B0yyI99g5XiCqHVUA/8TDu763UbFBKvHp5iCLeI763Rw)

clean_body: Hi folks! I just made it official: I‘m running for U.S. Senate! Folks - my name is Michele Tafoya. I made a career as a sideline reporter for some of the biggest moments in sports history. I spent many Sunday evenings out on the gridiron. And I've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? I never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... - STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares - DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents - ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports - OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants - FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool's errand. After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. But blazing my own trail has never scared me. I made history on TV and won four Emmys for my sports coverage. I've taken on longer odds than this - and I beat them. I'm taking on Tim Walz's inner circle, the DC power brokers, and the political class who have sold us out for too long. Luckily, there are a lot more of us than there are of them! Now that I have made my decision, my path to winning this Senate race is in your hands. The ONLY way we can flip this seat is by out-organizing, out-working, and out-raising our opponents. That last part is important - because if we can't get our message out far and wide, this race is over and the far-Left wins. | | ---|--- This just became one of the biggest Senate races in the entire country. I mean it. I'm already hearing that the career politicians are terrified of my campaign. They're scared because 120+ million people saw a viral video showcasing rampant fraud happening under Tim Walz's watch. They're scared because folks know who I am and they know I don't take BS from anyone - not from players on the field and certainly not from some empty suits in DC. And they're scared because they know that if the American people have to choose between fraud, incompetence, special interests, and powerful party bosses... And honesty, common sense, and plain talk - the political class is in for a reckoning. Are you with me? I can't do this without you! Thanks for taking the time to read this email! Together, we're going to make history - I can feel it in my bones. Be brave. Do good. - Michele Michele Tafoya Republican for Senate, Minnesota It's official - Michele Tafoya is running for U.S. Senate in Minnesota! | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. | | "I promise if you ever have to wear my shoes, you will want Doug Lloyd to walk that path with you." -- Lori Post, sister of homicide victim Terri Greene
Last month, I shared one of the most high-profile cold murder cases I have ever prosecuted. Today, I want to tell you about another. It is the brutal double homicide of Michael and Terri Greene at their rural Grand Ledge home that shook Eaton County to its core.
Eaton County has long been known as a safe place to live, where people leave their doors unlocked. That sense of security was shattered in September 2011, when Terri Greene's parents discovered that their daughter and her husband, Michael Greene, a retired Michigan State Police detective, had been brutally murdered. Michael was found inside their home. Terri was found floating in their backyard pond, with a wheelbarrow over her lifeless body. The case was featured on a TV crime show series: [Murder Comes to Town, Investigation Discovery](https://jrhsf9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001D03Zgm-F_vdHJ_xH5zmgKkpH8RbKlesm5VGtVkxB5g3gfJmOGMYgwoOzyy0rz7x-ieRuli7ojpvMpyRZd1aE5E265dQfejKjHqrk6uLg-z1aP90q3AtXhvAzyk3FOV6oD_fnM3aMpWKW09X5i0AldwvNjuQdKm8yp1fS1yV8j9EAimjgrkESQOatBYXMELCpZEubX07wr0Yhd6JxN4OXSZSFGmRmwMcCHUwWiZhkLB86U94hCVQbYXeVO6FhL84J&c=ROe_LaFqHfKTSPTX9RfqdXOD0KdcMoEXGHcWmJlG2PVZv4B_C8hq-Q==&ch=-yw51NxwpGjSGkIVRnd-tdWSUrCpN-ide4elCiM9B_sIf3qCeeZTow==)
At the time, I was serving as Chief Assistant Prosecutor of Eaton County and was immediately assigned as the lead prosecutor. With no suspect and very little evidence, our team began methodically following every lead. That included drafting piggyback search warrants to track activity on stolen credit cards taken from the home.
Those efforts would eventually pay off, but not before the killer nearly got away with it.
Working closely with Eaton and Ingham County detectives, we identified the suspected killer as Christopher Perrien. What made this case especially disturbing was that Perrien was already a convicted felon housed in the Eaton County Jail when the home invasion and double homicide occurred. He had been granted work release by the court. Instead of going to work, he spent his days driving through rural Eaton County, casing homes and committing home invasions. He was ultimately identified in part because of his distinctive red Pontiac Trans Am, a vehicle law enforcement knew he prized above everything else.
After Perrien was stopped by police, investigators obtained warrants for his storage unit. Inside, they found Mike Greene's stolen firearm and credit cards. A GPS device taken from Perrien's car became the most critical piece of evidence, though its admissibility was a concern.
This case became one of the first in Michigan where GPS metadata was accessed through a search warrant and successfully used at trial. That data, or breadcrumbs, placed Perrien at the murder scene and at the locations where the stolen credit cards were used. Our prosecution not only secured justice for the Greene family, it helped change Michigan case law on the use of cellphone and GPS data in criminal prosecutions.
We also exposed a serious public safety failure. When dangerous criminals are granted work release without proper vetting, communities pay the price.
After a jury trial lasting four weeks, I secured a first-degree murder conviction. Justice was served. And the people of Eaton County were reminded that their safety will always come first.
That is the kind of proven dedication and leadership I will bring as Michigan's next Attorney General: Law-focused. Victim-centered. And unwavering in the pursuit of justice.

clean_body: Safety for Eaton County | | | | | == | | | == | | "I promise if you ever have to wear my shoes, you will want Doug Lloyd to walk that path with you." -- Lori Post, sister of homicide victim Terri Greene Last month, I shared one of the most high-profile cold murder cases I have ever prosecuted. Today, I want to tell you about another. It is the brutal double homicide of Michael and Terri Greene at their rural Grand Ledge home that shook Eaton County to its core. Eaton County has long been known as a safe place to live, where people leave their doors unlocked. That sense of security was shattered in September 2011, when Terri Greene's parents discovered that their daughter and her husband, Michael Greene, a retired Michigan State Police detective, had been brutally murdered. Michael was found inside their home. Terri was found floating in their backyard pond, with a wheelbarrow over her lifeless body. The case was featured on a TV crime show series: == At the time, I was serving as Chief Assistant Prosecutor of Eaton County and was immediately assigned as the lead prosecutor. With no suspect and very little evidence, our team began methodically following every lead. That included drafting piggyback search warrants to track activity on stolen credit cards taken from the home. Those efforts would eventually pay off, but not before the killer nearly got away with it. Working closely with Eaton and Ingham County detectives, we identified the suspected killer as Christopher Perrien. What made this case especially disturbing was that Perrien was already a convicted felon housed in the Eaton County Jail when the home invasion and double homicide occurred. He had been granted work release by the court. Instead of going to work, he spent his days driving through rural Eaton County, casing homes and committing home invasions. He was ultimately identified in part because of his distinctive red Pontiac Trans Am, a vehicle law enforcement knew he prized above everything else. After Perrien was stopped by police, investigators obtained warrants for his storage unit. Inside, they found Mike Greene's stolen firearm and credit cards. A GPS device taken from Perrien's car became the most critical piece of evidence, though its admissibility was a concern. This case became one of the first in Michigan where GPS metadata was accessed through a search warrant and successfully used at trial. That data, or breadcrumbs, placed Perrien at the murder scene and at the locations where the stolen credit cards were used. Our prosecution not only secured justice for the Greene family, it helped change Michigan case law on the use of cellphone and GPS data in criminal prosecutions. We also exposed a serious public safety failure. When dangerous criminals are granted work release without proper vetting, communities pay the price. After a jury trial lasting four weeks, I secured a first-degree murder conviction. Justice was served. And the people of Eaton County were reminded that their safety will always come first. That is the kind of proven dedication and leadership I will bring as Michigan's next Attorney General: Law-focused. Victim-centered. And unwavering in the pursuit of justice. body:
Dan Goldman for New York [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP31/1/94087/images/Logo-White-BG.png]
Thank you so much, Peter.

My gratitude for this team’s support over the past year cannot be understated. Your donations, however big or small, truly motivate me and make my work possible.

Together, we worked hard in 2025 to defend our democracy, hold Donald Trump and MAGA Republicans accountable, protect our fundamental freedoms, and deliver for New Yorkers.

But as I’m sure you know, our work is far from over.

Our democracy is under threat like never before. We need to defend it, and it starts right here, with this team. Every bit of grassroots support — whether that’s volunteering, donating, or simply spreading the word — makes a huge difference.

As we move forward in 2026 determined to take back the House and start issuing subpoenas in January 2027, you will no doubt get a lot of requests for donations.

But I just want you to know that no matter what happens as we move forward, I’m forever grateful for your support to this point.

Thank you for standing with me.

— Dan

# **[Treasury chief brands Denmark"irrelevant" at Davos](https://substack.com/redirect/0c41a414-e633-4555-a67b-f6ce63cfd1d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent shrugged off market jitters at Davos Wednesday, **[declaring Denmark and its modest Treasury holdings"irrelevant"](https://substack.com/redirect/0c41a414-e633-4555-a67b-f6ce63cfd1d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** amid escalating tensions over President Trump's push to acquire Greenland from the Nordic nation.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/0c41a414-e633-4555-a67b-f6ce63cfd1d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Danish Sell-Off Dismissed** : Bessent downplayed a Danish pension fund's $100 million Treasury sale as insignificant, noting they've been reducing holdings for years with no concern for U.S. markets.
* **Greenland Security Imperative** : Bessent stressed Greenland must join the U.S. to safeguard Arctic interests, preventing potential conflicts with Russia and China as warming opens new trade routes.
* **Media Amplification Criticized** : Bessent blamed "fake news media" for hyping a single Deutsche Bank analyst's note on European asset sales, claiming record foreign investment in Treasuries continues.
* **Europe Urged Patience** : Bessent advised allies to "take a deep breath" and await Trump's arguments, predicting persuasion on national security needs without reflexive anger or bitterness.

# **[Venezuela pockets $300M from post-Maduro oil deal](https://substack.com/redirect/6a52eda7-3cac-4e10-b94e-e8aee5c4b608?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
Venezuela's interim president Delcy Rodriguez announced Tuesday that the country has **[received $300 million in initial proceeds](https://substack.com/redirect/6a52eda7-3cac-4e10-b94e-e8aee5c4b608?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** from a U.S.-brokered oil sales deal following Nicolas Maduro's capture, with funds aimed at stabilizing the economy amid ongoing political upheaval.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6a52eda7-3cac-4e10-b94e-e8aee5c4b608?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Oil Funds Allocated** : The $300 million will flow through Venezuela's exchange market via national banks and the central bank to consolidate stability and protect workers' incomes and purchasing power.
* **Law Reform Planned** : National Assembly President Jorge Rodriguez said upcoming hydrocarbons law changes will incorporate partnership models from the Maduro era to formalize new investment structures.
* **Investment Boost Targeted** : Interim government supports revising the rigid joint-venture model controlled by state-owned PDVSA to attract more foreign capital into the struggling sector.
* **Deal Context Emerges** : Proceeds stem from Trump's announced 50-million-barrel supply agreement, though shipping data shows the full volume has not yet been exported.

# [Ripple CEO predicts crypto all-time high](https://substack.com/redirect/7da6e672-e243-452c-861c-08d45eb36674?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Ripple CEO Brad Garlinghouse, speaking at the World Economic Forum in Davos on Tuesday, declared he's "very bullish" and **[predicted cryptocurrency markets will hit all-time highs this year,](https://substack.com/redirect/7da6e672-e243-452c-861c-08d45eb36674?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** citing surging institutional interest and recent regulatory breakthroughs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/76969798-9210-499f-a1f0-a9e94b8931cd?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Institutional Interest Surges** : Major financial institutions are deeply engaging with crypto, creating a "massive sea change" not yet fully reflected in current market prices.
* **Regulatory Wins Unlock Growth** : The GENIUS Act, passed in June, provides stablecoin guardrails like full reserves and audits, enabling massive scaling and efficiency in operations.
* **Ripple 's Legal Victory Stands**: SEC dropped its four-year lawsuit against Ripple in March after a $150 million defense, with Ripple winning key legal questions on XRP.
* **XRP Emerges Breakout Star** : Ripple's token surged as the rally's standout performer, trading around $1.90, while Bitcoin sits at $89,000 after its 2025 peak.

# [AI Giants Chase Enterprise Billions at Davos](https://substack.com/redirect/d4f7cd31-256d-40ab-b467-db534acf1db9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
At the World Economic Forum in Davos on Wednesday, OpenAI and Anthropic executives revealed their **[fierce push into enterprise markets](https://substack.com/redirect/d4f7cd31-256d-40ab-b467-db534acf1db9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , with enterprise now comprising 40% of OpenAI's business and a dominant 80% of Anthropic's revenue as both AI leaders compete aggressively for corporate adoption and stable growth in 2026.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d4f7cd31-256d-40ab-b467-db534acf1db9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Enterprise Dominates Anthropic** : The safety-focused company derives 80% of its revenue from businesses, viewing them as a more reliable and synergistic source compared to volatile consumer markets.
* **OpenAI Accelerates Corporate Shift** : With over 1 million business customers worldwide, enterprise makes up roughly 40% of OpenAI's business today, projected to approach 50% by year-end amid rapid growth.
* **Executives Stress Value Addition** : OpenAI CFO Sarah Friar emphasized closing capability gaps and delivering value to both consumers and enterprises, while Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei highlighted reliability advantages in corporate partnerships.
* **Valuations Reflect Massive Scale** : OpenAI boasts a $500 billion valuation with explosive growth since ChatGPT, while Anthropic, founded by ex-OpenAI leaders, has climbed to $350 billion on strong enterprise traction.

# [Trump teases mysterious Greenland takeover plan](https://substack.com/redirect/1ec57836-170f-453b-85e0-beee47bc8c13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
President Donald Trump cryptically declared **["You'll find out"](https://substack.com/redirect/1ec57836-170f-453b-85e0-beee47bc8c13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** when pressed on how far he'd go to acquire Greenland from Denmark, amid tariff threats against European nations and upcoming Davos talks, as he insists U.S. control of the Arctic island is vital for national security but rules out military force.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1ec57836-170f-453b-85e0-beee47bc8c13?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Cryptic White House stance** : Trump dodged specifics on acquisition methods during a lengthy briefing, heightening tensions after linking the push to recent geopolitical moves like the Maduro capture.
* **Tariff pressure tactics** : Administration threatened escalating duties on multiple European countries to force Greenland's handover, sparking market volatility and European retaliation warnings.
* **Arctic security imperative** : Trump repeatedly emphasized Greenland's critical role in countering Russia and China threats, declaring anything short of full U.S. control unacceptable for Arctic dominance.
* **Davos diplomacy ahead** : With meetings scheduled at the World Economic Forum, Trump predicted positive outcomes while European leaders, including Denmark, firmly resist and prepare countermeasures against coercion.

Fellow Patriot,

What happened **_this past Sunday_** in St. Paul should stop every church-going American cold.

**_A mob forced its way into a church during a Sunday worship service_** — during prayer — intimidating families, elderly parishioners, and children while shouting political slogans. This was not peaceful protest. It was an invasion of a sanctuary.

In a recent letter to its members nationwide, CatholicVote said it plainly: disrupting a church service is not protest — it is a crime. They are right. And it should alarm anyone who believes the First Amendment still matters.

The very first freedom protected in our Constitution is the free exercise of religion. Our Founders placed it first for a reason.

**_When people storm a sanctuary to intimidate worshippers, they are violating civil rights and crossing a line our nation was founded to defend._**

As a former Sheriff, I know the difference between lawful protest and lawlessness. As a candidate for Congress, I also know this: when leaders refuse to enforce the law, these attacks spread. Silence from those in power becomes permission for the next one.

**If a church can be invaded during prayer in Minnesota today, it can happen anywhere tomorrow.**

Our nation was founded on the belief that Americans could worship freely, without fear or intimidation. Protecting that freedom is not optional. It is a constitutional duty.

| | | | Alright, Peter, I’m just going to cut to the chase and say it: I MISS YOU!
For years, you’ve stood by me: stepping in when I needed it most and even generously contributing your hard-earned money to advance our conservative agenda.
**_And now, Peter, I’m asking you to stand with me once more... because this fight is far from over!_** **_

body:
[ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1001&akid=1584%2E251025%2Ex6sqKX ]Abdul for US Senate [ https://act.abdulformichigan.com/go/30?refcode=&t=1002&akid=1584%2E251025%2Ex6sqKX ]Abdul for US Senate

Peter,

This week, I stood outside the Whipple building — the ICE headquarters in
Minnesota — shoulder to shoulder with people, including Attorney General
Keith Ellison, who are tired of watching our government abuse its power
and shred the Constitution in the process.

[ A ]A screenshot of a video of Abdul talking with Keith Ellison at the ICE
protest in Minnesota

Across the country, ICE is being used as a blunt instrument of political
intimidation and violence. Communities are occupied. People are
disappearing. Constitutional rights are treated like suggestions.

And too many politicians are responding the same way they always do — with
silence, vague statements, or careful hedging meant not to upset anyone
with power.

Some establishment figures, like my primary opponent, are even suggesting
that we give ICE more taxpayer dollars to train them “better.”

In short, no real solutions.

Peter, when
federal agencies are being weaponized against our own people, someone has
to draw a line. Someone has to say plainly what this is, and what must
change.

That’s why I’ve said it clearly: Abolish ICE.

Not reform. Definitely not more funding.

Abolish it, and replace it with a system that respects due process, human
dignity, and the Constitution.

I’m the only candidate in this race willing to say the obvious out loud.

When you take a stand against powerful interests who prefer silence, they
don’t hesitate to fight back.

That means whether we win — and whether Michigan has a Senator willing to
stand up when it actually matters — comes down to grassroots support.

In solidarity,

Abdul

clean_body: [ ]Abdul for US Senate [ ]Abdul for US Senate Peter, This week, I stood outside the Whipple building — the ICE headquarters in Minnesota — shoulder to shoulder with people, including Attorney General Keith Ellison, who are tired of watching our government abuse its power and shred the Constitution in the process. [ A ]A screenshot of a video of Abdul talking with Keith Ellison at the ICE protest in Minnesota Across the country, ICE is being used as a blunt instrument of political intimidation and violence. Communities are occupied. People are disappearing. Constitutional rights are treated like suggestions. And too many politicians are responding the same way they always do — with silence, vague statements, or careful hedging meant not to upset anyone with power. Some establishment figures, like my primary opponent, are even suggesting that we give ICE more taxpayer dollars to train them “better.” In short, no real solutions. Peter, when federal agencies are being weaponized against our own people, someone has to draw a line. Someone has to say plainly what this is, and what must change. That’s why I’ve said it clearly: Abolish ICE. Not reform. Definitely not more funding. Abolish it, and replace it with a system that respects due process, human dignity, and the Constitution. I’m the only candidate in this race willing to say the obvious out loud. When you take a stand against powerful interests who prefer silence, they don’t hesitate to fight back. That means whether we win — and whether Michigan has a Senator willing to stand up when it actually matters — comes down to grassroots support. [ ]If you believe we need leaders who won’t look away as civil liberties are stripped from our communities, I’m asking you to chip in $10 today. Your contribution helps us get our message in front of more voters. [ ]Donate $10 ›› In solidarity, Abdul

Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
The Independent: Trump DOJ admits DOGE Social Security staff worked with political group trying to ‘overturn election results’ [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012126_2&amount=25]
Two members of Elon Musk’s DOGE team at the Social Security Administration were secretly working with a right-wing advocacy group trying to “overturn election results,” the Trump Department of Justice admitted in a court filing.
While the Social Security Administration (SSA) has not yet admitted whether voter data was actually shared with the group, SSA did admit the agreement bypassed internal safeguards designed to prevent exactly this kind of misuse of personal government data.
SSA also did not release the name of the right-wing political group that the DOGE staffers engaged in unauthorized communications and data planning tied directly to election denial efforts. We can be reasonably sure that it's MAGA-aligned, however.
This news is being lost in the avalanche of terrible things the Trump administration is doing, but this is a blaring red siren for both November and future elections . We must spread the word about this blatant attempt to overturn election results while we hold the administration accountable for this privacy violation and, above all, defend our fundamental right to vote.
Team, chip in to defend voting rights, inform voters, and make every vote count with $35 or whatever you can today >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=012126_2&amount=35]

DOJ also said that emails “ suggest that DOGE Team members could have been asked to assist the advocacy group by accessing [Social Security] data to match to the voter rolls. ”
You just know, Team, that if Trump's MAGA DOJ had to admit this in a court filing, it's bad. And likely much worse than we're being told so far. Which is exactly why we have to spread the word to every voter we can reach and act to protect both our data and our fundamental rights.

body:
# [](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/43706?t=1&akid=240621%2E444211%2EEwRqny)
Hi friends,
When I moved to Houston last year, I had a long to-do list—new routines, new community, a new sense of home. But the very first thing I knew I needed to do was register to vote in my new county.
That simple decision changed everything.
During my weekly walking group here in Houston, I met Aimee—a Volunteer Deputy Registrar (VDR) with Powered by People (PxP). Right there, in a space I already felt comfortable, she helped me update my voter registration. I remember thinking how powerful that was: voter engagement meeting people exactly where they are.
But it didn’t stop there.
Aimee followed up to let me know when my voter registration certificate arrived. She reminded me about upcoming election dates. And when I asked how I could get more involved, she generously shared how to become a VDR myself. Because of her and Beto’s Powered by People, I became a VDR for the first time last year. Today, I’m registered in multiple counties and serve the greater Houston area.
My curiosity and passion for the voting process kept growing. With the information and encouragement I received through PxP, I also became an Election Worker and worked my very first election last year.
Soon after, Aimee invited me to volunteer at a Powered by People event at the University of Houston. I joined more than 20 volunteers—college students, working adults, and retired Texans—all showing up with the same goal: to increase voter engagement and remind people that their voice matters.
At that event, PxP organizers and volunteers trained me on how to connect with students, help them check and update their voter information, register new voters, and stay in touch to remind them about upcoming elections while also answering questions. I heard stories from students and staff who were excited and relieved to have someone walk them through the process. That sense of connection and empowerment was unforgettable.
**_Hope is the word I keep coming back to._**
Powered by People is full of people who lead with hope—hope that first-time voters will feel confident, hope that communities long left out of political conversations will be heard, and hope that Texas can and will do better. Powered by People’s full-time organizers work behind the scenes to analyze data, maintain accurate voter information, and build partnerships with universities and community spaces so volunteers like me can show up informed, prepared, and effective.
Today, I’m a regular volunteer with Powered by People, and this year, I’ll even be hosting events for the first time.
I used to wonder: What more can I do beyond casting my vote and going about my day?
Now I know the answer.
I can help register voters.
I can help people navigate the voting process.
I can remind Texans that their voice matters because everything is political, and Texas deserves better.
[**If my story resonates with you, I hope you’ll consider making a donation to Powered by People’s organizing today. Your support directly fuels the training, data, outreach, and events that make stories like mine—and thousands of others—possible.**](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260121.pDuB5_&refcode=ema20260121-240621&t=3&akid=240621%2E444211%2EEwRqny)
**[Donate $3](https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20260121.pDuB5_&refcode=ema20260121-240621&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=22&akid=240621%2E444211%2EEwRqny)**
Together, we can keep showing up with hope and turning it into action.
With gratitude and determination,
Asha
Volunteer, Powered by People

Hi friends, it’s Jane Fonda!
You may know me as an actor. Or as a troublemaker who refuses to stay quiet when powerful interests abuse their power and threaten our future. That’s why I’m writing today — because now more than ever, it matters who holds the line.
When politics feels loud, chaotic, and cruel, you pay attention to leaders who actually deliver. My friend Rob Bonta is that kind of leader, and I’m so proud to be standing with him as he runs for re-election as California’s Attorney General. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?refcode=260121em_jf_jane-reelect-top-link&amount=25]
CHIP IN [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rb-email-26?refcode=260121em_jf_jane-reelect-top-button&amount=25]
I’ve worked alongside Rob in the climate fight for years, and I’ve seen up close what makes him different. He listens. He acts. And when powerful corporations or reckless politicians put people at risk, he doesn’t hesitate to take them on — even when it puts a target on his back.
As Attorney General, Rob has built a legal fortress around California by defending our freedoms, our communities, and our environment from relentless attacks by Donald Trump, Big Oil, and corporate interests that think the law doesn’t apply to them.
His office has brought historic lawsuits against oil and gas giants for their decades of deception about climate change. He’s taken on polluters who lied to the public, endangered our health, and put profits ahead of people. And he’s gone to court again and again to stop Trump’s attempts to freeze climate funding, dismantle environmental safeguards, and abuse federal power.
That work is precisely why Rob is under attack, and it's why I’m using my voice to make sure he has the resources and people power to win.
We are living through a moment when abuse of power is no longer theoretical. It’s happening in real time. And California’s Attorney General is one of the strongest checks we have against it.
Rob Bonta has proven he will use every tool of the law to protect families, defend vulnerable communities, and stand up for the California Dream — the idea that every single person who calls this state home deserves safety, dignity, and a fair shot at the future.
But change doesn’t happen on its own.
Rob can only continue this work if we have his back. If you’re with me — and you agree we need leaders who don’t flinch in the face of bullies and corporate profiteers — then I’d like to ask you to make a contribution to support his re-election campaign for California Attorney General. Congress is weaker than it’s ever been. Partisan warfare, gridlock, and
bad-faith obstruction have hollowed out the legislative branch — and the
conservative Supreme Court has seized the opportunity.

Instead of respecting Congress’s role as the people’s lawmaking body, this
extremist Court has used its paralysis to grab power for itself.

The damage is staggering.

As polarization has increased, the Court has grown bolder, erasing decades
of legal precedent, issuing decisions that benefit the ultra-wealthy, and
striking down laws protecting workers, voters, and democracy itself.

Make no mistake: none of this is because Congress exceeded its authority.
It’s because this Court believes it should have the final say.

But now, the stakes are even higher.

This Court is fast-tracking Trump’s authoritarian agenda — gutting checks
on executive power, shielding abuses, and bending the law for a man who
has promised “retribution.” That’s not how our democracy works. And it
won’t fix itself.

Reforming our courts is essential. That means fighting back against this
Court’s power grab, demanding accountability, and restoring Congress as
the people’s branch. Demand Justice PAC is on the front lines, but we
can’t do it without you.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260121.AGpJfn&refcode=em20260121-61102&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=1003&akid=61102%2E1407376%2EmBERso ]Chip in right now to help us reform the courts, push back against
authoritarianism, and protect our democracy before it’s too late.

[ https://act.demandjustice.org/go/55459?c0=dj-em-20260121.AGpJfn&amount=5&refcode=em20260121-61102&t=1022&akid=61102%2E1407376%2EmBERso ]Donate $5 ››

The Supreme Court broke Congress. And if we don’t act, it will keep
breaking our democracy — piece by piece.

Thank you,

Demand Justice PAC

subject: Jimmy Gomez just sided with Republicans and Trump AGAIN
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Justice Democrats
body:
Jimmy’s votes speak louder than his words.
#
Peter,
_**Last week, the House voted 341 to 79 to fund Trump’s war-driven foreign policy agenda in bill H.R. 7006.**_
**Jimmy Gomez voted YES.**
**Only 57 Democrats voted NO.**
The bill was a massive appropriations package that pours money into violence and human rights violations abroad while Trump slashes health care, food assistance, and lifesaving programs at home and around the world.
Let’s be clear about what this vote means:
While Americans are losing access to health care, while families are struggling to afford prescriptions, while clinics are closing and public health programs are under attack, _Congress just approved billions more to bankroll war and militarism._
At the same time, Trump has dragged us into an unconstitutional war in Venezuela, backed governments committing human rights abuses, ignored international law, and chosen threats and force over diplomacy.
**This bill funds that agenda._Jimmy Gomez voted for it anyway._**
I would not have.
I believe government should save lives, not take them. I believe we should be funding health care, housing, food, education, and peace, not endless wars and human rights abuses. I believe Congress has a responsibility to say no when a bill causes real harm to everyday people here and abroad.
That is why I’m running for Congress.
If we want representatives who will vote no on bills like this, who will put people before war, and who will refuse to rubber-stamp Trump’s cruelty, we have to build the power to elect them.
**[Please, chip in $5 today to my campaign and Justice Democrats to help send me to Congress, where I will stand up to Trump and be a voice for working families in CA-34.](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260121-agt.wCm5iF&refcode=em20260121-37388&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=2&akid=37388%2E1203867%2EQ9TU3n)** _Your donation helps our campaign organize, reach voters, and replace politicians who keep choosing war over people._
**[Contribute $5](https://go.justicedemocrats.com/go/140221?c0=jd-em-20260121-agt.wCm5iF&refcode=em20260121-37388&amounts=10%2C27%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&amount=5&t=21&akid=37388%2E1203867%2EQ9TU3n)**
These votes matter. And with your help, we can change who gets to make them.
Thank you for being part of this fight,
Angela

Peter —
In recent election cycles, the Democratic Party has lost major ground with Latino voters — especially in Texas. But we’re putting in the resources to reverse that trend.
**We just launched a statewide Spanish-language TV ad — earlier than any campaign in modern Texas history.**
I want to explain more about this decision and why it’s important to me in a moment, but if you understand the stakes and why this matters, **[please consider making a contribution to our campaign today. Airing this new Spanish-language ad is a major budget decision, but it could be what makes the difference in this race.](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q1.AKJ3HX&refcode=em260121-1-ak&t=1&akid=398%2E1347274%2E2eU3iz)**
[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q1.AKJ3HX&refcode=em260121-1-ak&t=2&akid=398%2E1347274%2E2eU3iz)
If we have any hope of taking back our beloved state, we have to engage more meaningfully with Latino communities and take no one for granted.
It’s going to require trying new things and putting in the extra work to meet people where they are and be thoughtful in how we spread our message.
That’s why we’re barnstorming the state and holding open town halls right in voters’ communities.
It’s why we’re designing our organizing and volunteer training materials in Spanish so we can reach voters at the doors in their own language.
It’s why we’re showing up on voters’ screens with our Spanish-language social media channels — speaking to folks directly in my (imperfect) Spanish.
[](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q1.AKJ3HX&refcode=em260121-1-ak&t=3&akid=398%2E1347274%2E2eU3iz)
And it’s why we’re investing major resources into reaching the 8 million Spanish-speaking Texans at scale on TV with this new Spanish-language ad.
[](https://act.jamestalarico.com/go/512?c0=jt-em-2026q1.AKJ3HX&refcode=em260121-1-ak&t=4&akid=398%2E1347274%2E2eU3iz)
Our party has a lot of work to do. If we’re going to win, we have to listen to, learn from, and earn the trust of Latino communities across the state — and we have to invest in reaching folks where they are.
All of this work takes significant resources. And I know that, if we want to win in November, this work has to start now.

clean_body: Peter — In recent election cycles, the Democratic Party has lost major ground with Latino voters — especially in Texas. But we’re putting in the resources to reverse that trend. We just launched a statewide Spanish-language TV ad — earlier than any campaign in modern Texas history. I want to explain more about this decision and why it’s important to me in a moment, but if you understand the stakes and why this matters, If we have any hope of taking back our beloved state, we have to engage more meaningfully with Latino communities and take no one for granted. It’s going to require trying new things and putting in the extra work to meet people where they are and be thoughtful in how we spread our message. That’s why we’re barnstorming the state and holding open town halls right in voters’ communities. It’s why we’re designing our organizing and volunteer training materials in Spanish so we can reach voters at the doors in their own language. It’s why we’re showing up on voters’ screens with our Spanish-language social media channels — speaking to folks directly in my (imperfect) Spanish. And it’s why we’re investing major resources into reaching the 8 million Spanish-speaking Texans at scale on TV with this new Spanish-language ad. Our party has a lot of work to do. If we’re going to win, we have to listen to, learn from, and earn the trust of Latino communities across the state — and we have to invest in reaching folks where they are. All of this work takes significant resources. And I know that, if we want to win in November, this work has to start now. name: Paul Callaghan
subject: This is really important
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Hampshire Republican State Committee, Chairman Paul Callaghan
body:
Chris Pappas was asked a straightforward question on Close Up: would he abolish ICE?

| | | | | [|
---](https://gop.us22.list-manage.com/track/click?u=6abc8216f2c93cdbede56dda3&id=06c1f580eb&e=f3aa6419cd)
| | | | | |

Friend,
**Chris Pappas was asked a straightforward question on Close Up: would he abolish ICE?**
He refused to answer.
Instead of being honest with Granite Staters, he dodged, deflected, and complained that Republican majorities are stopping him from getting his way. He called ICE “unacceptable.” He’s proposed cutting their funding. And when pressed on whether he would abolish the agency, he wouldn’t rule it out.
**That’s why this moment is CRUCIAL for our state and our country.**
Thanks to Republican leadership, New Hampshire banned sanctuary cities, strengthened cooperation with federal law enforcement, and made it clear that we stand with the men and women who keep our communities safe.
**But Democrats are organizing, flooding New Hampshire with outside money, and working overtime to flip that balance of power.**
**Not everyone can donate financially right now — and that’s okay. What matters is that we don’t sit this one out.**
This is a pivotal moment for New Hampshire. And there are real, meaningful ways you can help that don’t cost a dollar: knocking doors, making calls, helping at events, writing letters to the editor, and standing up for our values in your community.
Republicans win when everyday Granite Staters step up.
If you believe in enforcing the law, supporting law enforcement, and keeping New Hampshire safe, prosperous, and free, we need you on the team.
---

body:
*Here are a few immediate ways you can help this week:*

✅ Petition Season is Almost Here — We Need Your Help

We will begin collecting petition signatures on February 17th. This is one
of the most important early steps of the campaign — and it’s something
volunteers play an essential role in.

*How you can help with petitions:*

-

This *Thursday (tomorrow), January 22nd at 6:30 PM*, we are hosting a
virtual training to teach you everything you need to know to help with the
petition process. Register for Petition Training

We’re also hosting a fundraising event on *Wednesday, February 4*, and we’d

share on social media to help get the word out.

*Time:* 6:00 pm to 8:00 pm
*Location:* Gianelli's II Restaurant and Lounge
*Address:* 4816 US-30, Greensburg, PA 15601
*RSVP link: https://secure.actblue.com/donate/2-4kickoff

Fundraising is the fuel that keeps this campaign moving, and early momentum

As always, don’t hesitate to email me if you have information or

Thanks again for being part of this team — we’re grateful to have you with
us.

Best,
Kate

name: Mark Kelly
subject: Join me for an exclusive conversation:
body:
You’re invited to a conversation with Senator Mark Kelly:
---
Hi Derek, Senator Mark Kelly here. I’m excited to share that I will be hosting an exclusive conversation alongside the DNC Grassroots Team **tonight at 6 PM.** For speaking the truth and supporting the Constitution, President Donald Trump said I should be hanged. Now, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has formally censured me, and the DOD is trying to demote me and cut my pension, all for speaking out. They’ll never understand putting service to this country before themselves. President Donald Trump has made billions of dollars off his presidency while millions of people are wondering how they’ll afford their health care or how they’ll feed their kids. We’re heading into the most consequential midterm elections of our lifetime, and the stakes are higher than ever before. Fear is contagious, but so is courage, which is why it is critical now more than ever we all do our part and get involved to help elect Democrats nationwide. **That’s why I’m having this conversation with you.** There’s no telling what comes next. Unfortunately, we need to be prepared for any outcome. **I’ll be answering your questions about what’s ahead for 2026 and how we’re fighting each and every day for Americans.** [**Can you join me on Wednesday, January 21, at 6 PM for this upcoming briefing? Chip in any amount now to reserve your spot.**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dnc-briefing-mk?amount=7&refcode=em_20260121_5867_dc&refcode2=5867_22930333_ZMt31e&akid=5867%2E22930333%2EZMt31e) **[CHIP IN ANY AMOUNT TO RSVP](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/dnc-briefing-mk?amount=7&refcode=em_20260121_5867_dc&refcode2=5867_22930333_ZMt31e&akid=5867%2E22930333%2EZMt31e)** I am sticking up for the American people every single day, regardless of how this president threatens me. I’m looking forward to speaking with you. Mark

Fear is contagious, but so is courage, which is why it is critical now more than ever we all do our part and get involved to help elect Democrats nationwide. That’s why I’m having this conversation with you. There’s no telling what comes next. Unfortunately, we need to be prepared for any outcome. I’ll be answering your questions about what’s ahead for 2026 and how we’re fighting each and every day for Americans. I am sticking up for the American people every single day, regardless of how this president threatens me. I’m looking forward to speaking with you. Mark If you gave recently via check or mail, our system may not have yet processed your gift. We are appreciative and thank you greatly for your support.
