_**By David Shuster**_
In order to recognize the spectacle now afflicting the American people, you don't have to consult your favorite therapist, psychiatrist, or mental health expert. Just look at the U.S. stock tickers. The U.S. markets just suffered their worst trading losses in several months. Why? Because Donald Trump threw a temper tantrum at Europe over Greenland and threatened new tariffs.
That's Right. President Trump has once again reminded the world that the most dangerous thing in Washington D.C. is not ideology, foreign enemies, or even corruption, but rather a sulking child with access to the levers of economic power.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The market rout erased billions of dollars. Not because America is weak, but because Trump is erratic. Trump lashed out after Europe - responding to his threats to invade Greenland - dispatched more troops, planes, and ships to the Danish territory.
Trump keeps governing as if the presidency were a combination poker game and reality TV show. Trade policy, in his hands, is not a matter of economics but of Trump's mood. A nation or trading bloc that displeases him? Trump threatens tariffs. A leader of France or Norway fails to flatter Trump sufficiently and praise his Greenland vision? Trump rattles sabers. A headline that wounds Trump's vanity? The global economy must pay.
This is not strategy. It is emotional incontinence.
Economists, and even the kids learning basic economics in high school, understand that markets thrive on predictability and clear rules. Trump offers neither. He lurches from threat to retreat, from bombast to denial, leaving investors, allies, and citizens alike wondering if tomorrow's policy will be announced by briefing, tweet, or late-night impulse. The result is the economic equivalent of seasickness. It is constant and debilitating.
* * *

* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
What makes all of this even more grotesque is that the losses are piling up not merely because of Trump's incompetence. His toddler-like lack of emotional control is also crashing markets. Trump does not argue about whether the U.S. really needs to "own Greenland" to build a missile defense system or extract its minerals and precious metals. Denmark and Greenland say the U.S. can build as many bases and deploy as much military equipment as Trump wants. And the Danes say they will split mining proceeds with U.S. companies. But Trump insists Greenland must belong to him. Period.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
And with Trump, there can be no negotiation, only appeasement. Anything less and Trump postures, shrieks, and writes a juvenile stream of consciousness threats on social media. Trump's diplomacy resembles a schoolyard bully who seizes a ball and threatens to puncture it unless the other children applaud, cheer him loudly, and say how great he is.
One is tempted to apply the word "insanity" to Trump. But that would be unfair to the mildly deranged, many of whom possess at least some internal consistency. Trump's mind is disordered and ungoverned.
* * *
[Share](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=185244165&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&utm_content=share&utm_campaign=email-share&action=share&triggerShare=true&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg1MjQ0MTY1LCJpYXQiOjE3NjkwMjU1MzEsImV4cCI6MTc3MTYxNzUzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.xLFOGZRDIjVxUpUlrf1Afjm9CQgrv2gzGLjI_ev89Vk)
* * *
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
It is a place where impulse reigns supreme, and consequence is an afterthought. Trump's pronouncements are untethered from reason, experience, or any discernible plan beyond immediate gratification.
So, Trump is threatening Europe with new tariffs for standing up to him on Greenland. Trump either doesn't know or doesn't care that Europe owns a lot of the U.S. debt. The Europeans could call in the U.S. debt and dump their dollar reserves, sending the value of our currency into a death spiral. The U.S. economy, which relies on the dollar being the global reserve currency, would then collapse. The inflation that would ensue would make the Covid era spikes look like a rounding error.
And never mind the economic calamities, there are also the potential U.S. military challenges. If U.S. troops seize Greenland, European nations would almost certainly demand the closure of every U.S. military base on their continent, including Ramstein in Germany, Aviano in Italy, and Lakenheath in the U.K.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
[Leave a comment](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=3722532&post_id=185244165&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email&isFreemail=true&comments=true&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg1MjQ0MTY1LCJpYXQiOjE3NjkwMjU1MzEsImV4cCI6MTc3MTYxNzUzMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTM3MjI1MzIiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.xLFOGZRDIjVxUpUlrf1Afjm9CQgrv2gzGLjI_ev89Vk&r=1hvr60&utm_campaign=email-half-magic-comments&action=post-comment)
* * *
Without those bases, America's ability to project power and influence the Middle East and Africa would vanish overnight.
The fact that Trump commands the most powerful military on earth AND the largest economy would be hilarious if it were not so frightening and expensive. The costs are already rising quickly. Retirement accounts are shuddering, businesses are freezing new investments, and now our allies are hedging against American instability.
Meanwhile, Trump keeps preening before the cameras, mistaking attention for achievement and chaos for strength.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cb60717a-d060-4589-bd7e-d78f3ad6a6d9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The American people were once told that a wealthy real estate businessman would bring discipline and skill to government. Instead, we have gotten a tantrum-prone autocrat who treats global finance like a toy drum to be beaten loudly whenever his feelings are hurt.
Markets, like civilizations, eventually adapt. They price in risk. Increasingly, they are pricing in Trump himself--not as a leader, but as a hazard. And that is the most damning verdict of all: the President of the United States has become a volatility index.

Canada’s Prime Minister gave a rousing rebuke to Trump from the podium yesterday. Everyone is watching to see what Trump says.

In the Oval Office, in front of the press pool, at speeches and rallies, he simply cannot stop himself from constantly attacking me, spreading conspiracy theories, and putting a target on the back of my community.

It’s an important moment in history: Trump is threatening to take over Greenland and upend the international order. He continues to slap huge tariffs on our allies, driving up prices for Americans. The US economy is precarious at best. Canada’s Prime Minister gave a rousing rebuke to Trump from the podium yesterday. Everyone is watching to see what Trump says. But of course, Trump uses this critical moment to attack me. Because he is obsessed with me. And over the last weeks, and really the last few months, he just can’t keep my name out of his mouth. In the Oval Office, in front of the press pool, at speeches and rallies, he simply cannot stop himself from constantly attacking me, spreading conspiracy theories, and putting a target on the back of my community. I’ll be honest, I haven’t had time to respond to each attack because my district and my state is under a brutal ICE occupation. clean_body: Chaos, Cruelty, Corruption – One year into Donald Trump’s second term | = Hi Peter, Donald Trump’s first year back in office has been a long, exhausting, and revealing 12 months. But while the Trump administration’s greed and cruelty have become clearer each day, so has our path to stop him. Starting on day one of his second term, Trump moved quickly to cut Americans’ health care, threaten independent officials, and elevate dangerous yes-men and anti-choice conspiracy theorists within his administration. But where the Trump administration has created chaos, we’ve created a blueprint to take back power. = | = Donald Trump campaigned on promises to lower the price of living and put Americans’ interests first — promises he promptly broke once he stepped back into office. He’s imposed tariffs on America’s allies to escalate his petty and personal feuds — playing with our economy at the expense of Americans’ jobs and livelihoods. When he needed to cover the cost of adding $3.4 trillion to our national debt, Trump coerced Republicans in Congress to gut Medicaid coverage for the most vulnerable Americans — a feat that they cheered on in the House chamber. Trump and his Republican Party have fit a lot of chaos into just one year. But EMILYs List has spent the year elevating and working with bold leaders across the country who can deliver the change Americans are looking for. Every single one of our EMILYs List-endorsed candidates advanced in or won their races this past November — and we know our 2026 candidates have what it takes to do the same. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue, your donation will go through immediately: = | = ---|--- = | = = | = Talk soon, Amanda Sherman Baity (she/her/hers) Chief Communications Officer, EMILYs List = | | | | ---|---|---|---|--- Thank you for being a supporter of EMILYs List. **Through it all, I've learned the importance of asking for help when it's needed — _especially_ when faced with a difficult situation.**

**[So I'll be blunt with you:_Your country_ needs your help right now to flip the Senate blue >>](https://go.dscc.org/go/22350?amount=5&t=12&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FD-20260121-MarkKelly-KellyFlagVCRF-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FD-20260121-MarkKelly-KellyFlagVCRF-Pros-sl1&akid=22086%2E9716520%2EnaYbkX)**

2. Trump controls _all_ the power of the American presidency, and he's using it to attack and intimidate people into silence — making our job as Democrats even harder.

I’ve fought against Trump’s illegal tariffs that would devastate our economy. Reversed $187 million in counterterrorism cuts. Ensured abortion rights are protected in New York. No matter what B.S. comes out of Washington, I will always fight for your family like I’d fight for my own. Peter, that’s why I’m humbly asking for your personal endorsement, because D.C. Republicans and their special interest donors will raise millions into this race to flip New York red. Endorsements like yours will help me prove the strength of our campaign and carry us to victory. | Thank you from the bottom of my heart, Kathy | Before Kathy was born, her parents lived in a trailer by a steel plant near Buffalo. Her dad spent long days working at the steel mill while he pursued an education. Her mom raised six kids at home. Growing up, life wasn’t always easy for them — which is why Kathy has dedicated her life to fighting for families like hers. | = Governor Hochul with her siblings As Governor, Kathy has put money back in New Yorkers’ pockets, invested to keep New York’s streets and subways safe, delivered free school meals to ensure no child goes hungry — and stood up to Donald Trump’s attacks on New York families. Now, as the Trump administration continues to attack New Yorkers’ rights, Kathy is fighting him tooth and nail. She’s taking on his administration — and winning. No one — not Trump, not Bruce Blakeman, not any MAGA Republican — will stand between Kathy and her work to protect every New Yorker. But she can’t take on this fight alone — and she needs the support of folks like you to prove she has what it takes to continue her fight against Trump and MAGA Republicans. Will you rush in $15 to help Kathy’s campaign? = Thank you so much! Friends for Kathy Hochul P.O. Box 1463 New York, NY 10021 United States Email is the best way to stay in touch with our supporters. body:

Friend: I've always carried a sense of duty to protect our public lands — and that's because our public lands, national parks, monuments, and wildlife refuges belong to _all of us_.

Growing up fishing with my dad and running through the deserts with my cousins, I learned from a young age that we have a responsibility to take care of our planet.
So what do we do when our public lands are under attack? **We fight back.**

Right now, the Trump administration is doing _everything in its power_ to rollback environmental progress across the country and right here at home. It’s critical that we stand up against them.
_**[Please, will you make a gift of $5 more now to help power my campaign for Governor of New Mexico and stand up to this administration’s destructive agenda that threatens New Mexico’s future?](https://act.debhaaland.com/go/4353?t=2&akid=6989%2E400544%2EBCYJxm)**_

_Meeting with National Park staff while I served as the Secretary of the Interior_
Our public lands are breathtaking, friend, but even more than that, they're vital for our well-being, delivering fresh air to breathe, clean water to drink, and community with our neighbors.

Now more than ever, we need a leader who can meet this moment and stand up to MAGA allies and corporate polluters who are hell-bent on destroying our lands for profit.

**With experience protecting 674 million acres of land and water, I know I'm the best person for the job, friend.**
**As governor, I’ll step up to conserve our lands and waters for future generations, secure clean air and water for our communities, and mitigate the risk that wildfires pose to families across our state._But I can only deliver on this promise with your support._

Terror is NOT immigration policy. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123767138/596498178/693975070?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MTExMyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmODA0ODcwYS0wNmY3LWYwMTEtOGQ0Yy0wMDIyNDgyZDI3OWIiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=wwgftzg6q2r4I0bC4YSdEjZWoVkYJArION8gW4MPmtI=&emci=367c837a-e8f6-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=f804870a-06f7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=15820338)

**People are scared, Peter.**

In cities nationwide, ICE is operating with impunity. Masked officers are hiding their identities, enacting raids without warrants, breaking windows and pulling people out of their cars, tearing families apart, and leaving our communities shaken.

And in Minneapolis, that fear turned deadly with the lethal shooting of Renee Good, a U.S. citizen, by an ICE officer with unchecked power. It didn’t stop there. We’ve seen other violent interactions. ICE is stirring up chaos and making our streets, particularly in Minneapolis, dangerous. They're even putting local police in danger!

I want to be absolutely clear about something: the Trump Administration is the one allowing this to happen.

They could stop these aggressive tactics. Instead, they stand by and make excuses while ICE detains American citizens and immigrants who are here legally without transparency, without training, without rules, and without consequences. The result has been terror and tragedy on the ground for immigrants, for American citizens, and for entire neighborhoods that no longer know who is knocking at their door or whether the law will protect them.

_This approach is destroying the trust between communities and law enforcement.

Trust between neighbors and their government.

And trust that the people in power are acting in our best interests._

I've been hearing from people across our state and district, and right now **it's clear that even immigrants who are in the U.S. legally are living in fear. And we should all be concerned about which group(s) will be targeted next.**

ICE must be held accountable. Officers must identify themselves. Masks need to be banned. Warrants must be obtained and presented. The agency must be demilitarized and required to follow the law— _just like everyone else._

And the politicians who enabled this chaos must be held accountable, too.

body:
Donald Trump is weaponizing the federal government to target his political opponents.
---
| | Peter,

After I reminded our servicemembers of their obligations to uphold their oaths to the Constitution, Donald Trump called for me to be arrested, tried for treason, and executed.

Peter,

What happened **_this past Sunday_** in St. Paul should stop every church-going American cold.

**_A mob forced its way into a church during a Sunday worship service_** — during prayer — intimidating families, elderly parishioners, and children while shouting political slogans. This was not peaceful protest. It was an invasion of a sanctuary.

In a recent letter to its members nationwide, CatholicVote said it plainly: disrupting a church service is not protest — it is a crime. They are right. And it should alarm anyone who believes the First Amendment still matters.

The very first freedom protected in our Constitution is the free exercise of religion. Our Founders placed it first for a reason.

**_When people storm a sanctuary to intimidate worshippers, they are violating civil rights and crossing a line our nation was founded to defend._**

As a former Sheriff, I know the difference between lawful protest and lawlessness. As a candidate for Congress, I also know this: when leaders refuse to enforce the law, these attacks spread. Silence from those in power becomes permission for the next one.

**If a church can be invaded during prayer in Minnesota today, it can happen anywhere tomorrow.**

Our nation was founded on the belief that Americans could worship freely, without fear or intimidation. Protecting that freedom is not optional. It is a constitutional duty.

[**If you believe churches should remain protected ground, if you believe the First Amendment still means what it says, I ask you to stand with me today.**](http://links.itsourgreatamerica.com/u/click?_t=442fb7cf105f4725a8bda0b6bcffc1bd&_m=4849e70d06e6407b868354cfdc0ea386&_e=cxv7cqGsybo3AbTE0ucC3ILT9uU0gARArS00dA9wWdasSd1H5ZXqjLuHT3DpSlb_FDRAPplkTU5l1BxTSZG1CGuycIIwFGDmsR-qBoU0M1U1mS4UC4q7eWsUrurTcqFewYAhAKiCySjLYWwBVMTFF2Q7s3MMB5NcAQzsHY3pIVNC615bP03THKjmw_QyeHVgklwq3R4msbTUO0Y0g9Bp1yK4SV3k_DmfBcsXO45f9L83WabitY0UYoyBMJSbwienMDb990qI-rXX9uyXxDZ4vTeBiAUBsiEwWWjqm8A5YuE_RhSAB7TJR4se6hBND6SovNrrkP54En2pP6-OyubAipg9GoWZg_bCJ1qZgy48rMIJunvRhGb1IJrh0jFs4B90_SfOxbu_YZfZwwnkeggnwcQlt6XyLo8b4uHQZZHT5U-QWVs-nvvKbeQEQgkY75cRHdeUeOvltNAA_LcQ344Ej2YhluKBtRClUY5WgCnED_-9recgsYrAbRqVEprEW1qdGNqNAi_cS1eLw3lWq-aPvrG7mHLuoTduLbH10INRRYxlpd_zaA6XxeltuSjK7yVDNydZ57vraFz6zSkzCLF0ZZZsschMy3roBs-4l6unVMh5fhVPdTLjpRD2yzAfAW4R0Ynp_vRG0AyAP6U1PEiasrvaTXU0PYbdlcMTAzIzfwA%3D)

clean_body: | Peter, What happened this past Sunday in St. Paul should stop every church-going American cold. A mob forced its way into a church during a Sunday worship service — during prayer — intimidating families, elderly parishioners, and children while shouting political slogans. This was not peaceful protest. It was an invasion of a sanctuary. In a recent letter to its members nationwide, CatholicVote said it plainly: disrupting a church service is not protest — it is a crime. They are right. And it should alarm anyone who believes the First Amendment still matters. The very first freedom protected in our Constitution is the free exercise of religion. Our Founders placed it first for a reason. When people storm a sanctuary to intimidate worshippers, they are violating civil rights and crossing a line our nation was founded to defend. As a former Sheriff, I know the difference between lawful protest and lawlessness. As a candidate for Congress, I also know this: when leaders refuse to enforce the law, these attacks spread. Silence from those in power becomes permission for the next one. If a church can be invaded during prayer in Minnesota today, it can happen anywhere tomorrow. Our nation was founded on the belief that Americans could worship freely, without fear or intimidation. Protecting that freedom is not optional. It is a constitutional duty. Respectfully, Mark Lamb Sheriff, Pinal County, Arizona (Ret.) Hi Peter, I’ve been all over Texas, recruiting candidates across the ballot, raising volunteers for our voter registration work, and working with those volunteers to register and stay in touch with new voters across the state. Meeting folks who are stepping into the fight for the first time, joining old friends who’ve been there from the beginning, and talking with new voters to understand their perspectives and what it will take to bring more of them into the next election — all of that makes me feel confident that what we’re doing is key to winning big elections in Texas in 2026. There’s a place for consultants, pollsters, social media, and TV (I guess), but that’s not us. Powered by People is focused on meeting people where they’re at, showing them the respect they deserve, and working with them to overcome the most intense voter suppression in the country so that we can win power back for the people. But (you knew this part was coming): we can’t do this without you. This movement is going to take all of us, the organizer, the volunteer, the voter, and you. I’d like to show all those volunteers out there the kind of support we’ve built behind them. Every dollar keeps us on the ground, helps us bring new voters onto the rolls, and ensures that we can do the essential work needed for 2026 and beyond. Friends, can you imagine if House Republicans used their majority to pass some major, impactful legislation to make health care more affordable, lower grocery costs, and hold Donald Trump accountable?
I wish I were writing to tell you they’d done just that. Here’s the legislation they actually passed: “the SHOWER Act.”
It adopts new water pressure standards for showerheads.
At a moment when families are being crushed by high costs, when our freedoms are under attack, when Donald Trump is openly destroying our democracy — this is what House Republicans are spending their time on.
It would be laughable if it weren’t such a clear example of just how fundamentally incapable this Republican majority is of governing. They either don’t care about the problems facing people across this country, or they simply lack the backbone to stand up and do something about it all.
It’s hard to say which is worse.
This week we also mark the first full year of Trump 2.0.
As we reflect on what the past year has brought, and all that might lie ahead — in the Oval Office, in the House of Representatives, and in our communities — I understand the impulse to retreat. To be paralyzed by fear, unsure of how best to fight back, or just exhausted by the prospect.
I won’t tell you to buck up. I will tell you this:
I’m not paralyzed by fear, and I’m not exhausted. I’m ready to fight back, and I’m ready to win.
I’m incredibly grateful for the many, many people in San Diego, across California, and around the country who are stepping up to hold those in power accountable. Joining nonviolent protests, exercising your First Amendment rights, and standing up for your neighbors — thank you, truly.
At the same time, you shouldn’t have to do this alone. Your elected leaders should fight for you, and that’s exactly what I will keep doing. I will use every tool I have to defend your rights, lower your costs, and stand up to abuse of power — and I will work every day to make sure we’re ready to flip the House this November, so we can do all that and more.
If you can help, I’d be grateful for a contribution to support this work. No amount is too small — it all adds up. You can chip in at this link or by clicking the buttons below: secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em]

clean_body: [] Friends, can you imagine if House Republicans used their majority to pass some major, impactful legislation to make health care more affordable, lower grocery costs, and hold Donald Trump accountable? I wish I were writing to tell you they’d done just that. Here’s the legislation they actually passed: “the SHOWER Act.” It adopts new water pressure standards for showerheads. At a moment when families are being crushed by high costs, when our freedoms are under attack, when Donald Trump is openly destroying our democracy — this is what House Republicans are spending their time on. It would be laughable if it weren’t such a clear example of just how fundamentally incapable this Republican majority is of governing. They either don’t care about the problems facing people across this country, or they simply lack the backbone to stand up and do something about it all. It’s hard to say which is worse. This week we also mark the first full year of Trump 2.0. As we reflect on what the past year has brought, and all that might lie ahead — in the Oval Office, in the House of Representatives, and in our communities — I understand the impulse to retreat. To be paralyzed by fear, unsure of how best to fight back, or just exhausted by the prospect. I won’t tell you to buck up. I will tell you this: I’m not paralyzed by fear, and I’m not exhausted. I’m ready to fight back, and I’m ready to win. I’m incredibly grateful for the many, many people in San Diego, across California, and around the country who are stepping up to hold those in power accountable. Joining nonviolent protests, exercising your First Amendment rights, and standing up for your neighbors — thank you, truly. At the same time, you shouldn’t have to do this alone. Your elected leaders should fight for you, and that’s exactly what I will keep doing. I will use every tool I have to defend your rights, lower your costs, and stand up to abuse of power — and I will work every day to make sure we’re ready to flip the House this November, so we can do all that and more. If you can help, I’d be grateful for a contribution to support this work. No amount is too small — it all adds up. | | | **My team and I are so excited to kick off this year's Legislative Session in Richmond for our first week of the 2026 Legislative Session!** On Wednesday, I was sworn in, surrounded by family, and I am ready to fight for you! I am filled with gratitude and am honored to be your Delegate. Keep reading for more updates!

* * *
**2026 Session** We are assigned to General Laws, Education, and Transportation Committees, and cannot wait to deliver for working families in District 22! **We voted _YES_ on four constitutional amendments: **
****
* **HJ1**(fundamental right to reproductive freedom).
* **HJ2**(qualifications of voters and the right to vote; persons not entitled to vote).
* **HJ3**(Constitutional amendment; marriage between two adult persons; repeal of same-sex marriage prohibition; affirmative right to marry).
* **HJ4** (congressional districts; limited authority of the General Assembly to modify).

I've had an incredible time back at the Capitol, surrounded by colleagues, advocates, and constituents who care deeply about Virginia’s future. One of the highlights was attending the swearing-in of **Virginia’s****first female Governor** — a historic moment and a powerful reminder of the progress we’re making and the work still ahead.
I am proud to be on the House floor, meeting with community leaders, and pushing forward policies that reflect our values and the voices of the people we serve. I’m grateful for the opportunity to do this work — _and I’m just getting started._ The work doesn’t stop when the gavel comes down. And as we look ahead, I remain committed to bringing your priorities with me into every fight that lies ahead.

* * *
**I am so excited to share my legislative agenda for the 2026 Session:****** **HB 413:** Board of Education; Board of Nursing; High School Certified Nurse Aid Training and Certification Program established; requirements; report. **HB 414:** Selective Service; Two-Year College Transfer Grant; Virginia Tuition Assistance Grant Program. **HB 415:** Official emblems and designations; state fruit; pawpaw. **HB 416:** Use of school buses for public purposes by local governing bodies; insurance reimbursement. **HB 417:** Public institutions of higher education in the Commonwealth; in-state tuition eligibility; children of certain active duty members and veterans. **HB 494:** Virginia Personnel Act; hiring preference in state government; certain former federal employees. **HB 495:** School boards; mental health awareness training; anonymous student reporting system. **HB 496:** Siting of data centers; site assessment; water use disclosures. **HB 497:** Certain students with disabilities; certain communication, reporting, and data posting. **HB 953:** Department of Housing and Community Development; **HB 955:** State Council of Higher Education for Virginia; public institutions of higher education; certain annual student demographic data. **HB 957:** Department of Education; anonymous student bullying tip line established.
* * *
**Committee Recap** **General Laws** I am proudly serving on the General Laws Committee, and my work here affects matters for everyone in the district. Matters concerning government transparency, housing, and gaming all fall under this committee's purview. **Education** I also have the pleasure of serving on the Education Committee this session. With attacks on public education from the federal government, it is more important than ever to protect one of the best public school systems in the country, from K-12 to Higher Education. **Transportation** Finally, I am pleased to say that I am also serving on the Transportation Committee. Having experience working with the Transportation Authorities across the Commonwealth, I will continue to provide insight and review best practices to ensure safe and efficient ways to move people and goods across the Commonwealth.

**Local Business Highlight** We’re featuring excellent individuals and small businesses in the 22nd District in our newsletters! If you’d like to nominate someone or have your business be considered, please email: **[deleguzman@house.virginia.gov](mailto:deleguzman@virginia.house.gov)****.** Today, we’re giving a shout-out to **_Hector’s of Nokesville_**** _!_** Authentic Mexican flavors and warm hospitality are the name of the game at this hidden gem. Look, being a former Republican isn’t my whole story.
My mother immigrated from the Philippines as an organic chemist. I followed in her footsteps and majored in biochemistry before I went to Law School to pursue my true passion – Constitutional Law.
Looking back, the Constitution was my first love. At 10, I was obsessed with the Watergate Scandal. ( Little did I know that was child's play compared to what Trump would do ).
I know that sounds boring and nerdy, but the promise of our democracy, freedoms, and the rule of law fascinates me – and for years I thought Republicans upheld those same ideals.
I was so wrong. When I finally got a peek under the hood and saw what these lying, sleazebag, horrible MAGA loyalists were doing to our country, I couldn’t stomach it.
Let me be straight with you: Republicans are failing America, and as someone who’s been fighting Trump for years, I know exactly how to stop them.
It requires not running the same plays, election after election, hoping we’ll see different results. It means being bold and not afraid to fight fire with fire – like I’ve been doing at the cost of my career and reputation.
Look, Democrats’ success last November proved there’s hope. Trump may think he’s a king on a throne, but his wannabe dictatorship is built on a house of cards, and we are this close to toppling it.
If we can take back Congress for Democrats, we can cut Trump’s MAGA agenda off at the knees. To do it, we need a fearless candidate who knows what makes the MAGA machine tick, and who can rewrite the playbook and WIN.
That’s why I’m running, Peter . I’ve seen firsthand the devastation wrought by the selfishness and narcissism of Trump’s MAGA regime. We cannot let this be our future. The fight to keep men out of women's sports isn't over.

Dear Friend of Truth,

Imagine waking up to this message from your high school:

"Vandalism to school property. Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation."

And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth.

[ SEND A MESSAGE OF SUPPORT](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/uEMx1Tj3YzsK9YvsuO8YhpTxvzxOgGIJflJpyf-MWaZQWeq9wOBtQhPqM5dvhcpJke78b1OyshqheWGUEbTUxRvsd-GlQtNjdaNEdHeW9PMojHiROUjFF-uOtHqlWwd4kfhiL17dVSCe1iCdT2K-_bi74H4OdlP01tqEiu2B8i49lruYM3yY6hcKT54sEBOc910GqISEGWf3fXzHXHAKAL2KrREg5oYx3xf3ZriVQtuvWHXWyZNWsr9MA0i5X_QhojlzyPm-8yDRvunCl214glLhzOMAm7zorAb6J7ldI6xrGwuOVCSuBhKnb8u0wyA3wel0aJdaotq7wzM9ZBLak4eRmkXeIwtwUJB475ztz8AEkwjXD35QUb2a_6woHhJ1t5RocX_W32_0GUG0v2Dqi7fdKG_bc3IcFTllNR8CdWofzei11QaGj3Oht2sbHFyHSe9GaQ7IQ1RE2AtfEfzAZCKgKF2zUlti3zOTFQoiOWZ7sVLptM4aS-VijFiNfUP4sRseJCusITmIcGJCjzksCGqIJqqPpF_ISrcnoSj74WiKswh0j5olnK8I0X2lV85OmuVEPUPiIEKuL0dFDgqBHeQLuQWyRzKRp4MbuT1Nj0sgp34rg2L8w-B1L__Fgn-W9M6KXlTJcyh_58hlbIik9C37BW1pGoBT04cnz3um9RlMlBP3haRpf3jOcHgdMLdZqUi73ApAHNoCdJ-e0meYT2K8yKBgdE4jvxbNS-5I6PDvTvHXPtp3nvg3TAY5U6cTdoNzLQ3z0SbnYKQ/ZqP3Pim1dHi_EysRwOMj8QVphwI_1ycu/17)

That's exactly what happened to Gabby Stout. She had expressly asked permission to paint the message--and the school had given it.

**But the next day, after she and her friends painted the rock with the messages "Freedom 1776" and "Live Like Kirk--John 11:25," school officials sent out a school-wide email accusing them of vandalism and launched a criminal investigation.**

And it got worse. The local news widely reported on the "vandalism" and "investigation"--and school officials hauled Gabby into an office and forced her to write a statement describing her actions and show them her phone logs.

School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation.

The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer.

Of course, [this student and her friends had NOT committed vandalism.](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/JucyXNhMcYax35FgtkQ7map6sdC08LOOIctJOyLowg4N3wweQmpBhR-1yLtD3LFbBh96YqLYc7ciQQUQHV3BYu1gkbH6GI5kwl1o6sqI7oKdzqMRA3VccwiW1ffcIs-Psg_fHGJLi-CBv-mwXLf0Say3E9JwQft4SyVQbXPpIVqJMQR5yDWEA0QpQtxAlNn8UqNs4fxEUu4iSVBjXlwcHhm_j-jllquvLBuBP4rNUQ_Pq1wUDbvwW_jy_t_Pg6aGciMQd8zJpfQFYeSGMskOwxZmla6MewktoByevbG9GdN-ugrXJvrteL83C-ew7uBAr6UCyk5a3o2Ox_stf-1-SGws9pmbM_mjpZvdRAWrLXL8y_b7a9t_e7GTyJT26MlIhadffJHbXGn96M3Ls-UiGhHaU7uHyNrjsXqotCOuj3h-xgPQ9suYmqgAlIB5zfKvq_o4-OZ8sQ6_A1sw3I80dAEoCxXm-kH1xs_D-rUYQL5Ec0qtH2QIacqm-oPdA9KtrhG9AocjwslsyQh24QJblre46dIz8VvUsdUWwOOJQolu8zfetsFjdeQP5RtTOZKsCpS9oKW4KNLIRWfaaInPfGGQkYczwKPO5J19FEvHNL3mfwjR_-k4DEXWG0b-mdZFm69C_dClj0keD-LfLD7pQfTQG8TYx0lB6MlGWEpmwXd5dmIVw4NtbjncDkuMXSBqMdIxRMMwWo-nPAPAgWsrF2ERFDqYZ1zmM8Qmrn0hakhCwsoOVv_CpdWds--EF-sTRheMJEvwX2CnQUE/ReMaNxRGVo9Lw59UJlW9bXPj1liXg-uR/17) So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and __released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. __

A few days later, the school unveiled a "Revised Spirit Rock Speech Code" that only allowed "positive school spirit" and messages that "uphold the inclusive values of our school community."

**It explicitly bans students from expressing religious or political messages on the spirit rock --and allows the school officials to subjectively decide which messages are "positive." **

The Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education, which targeted and unlawfully investigated Gabby, violated her First, Fourth, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendment rights.

**These school officials cannot be allowed to get away with harassing and accusing a high schooler who did nothing wrong --just because they disagree with her views. **

Alliance Defending Freedom is suing the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education to make sure it will answer for its blatantly unconstitutional actions--punishing students for their views. But this is a lot for a high schooler to go through--so we want to make sure she knows that she isn't standing alone.

**Will you take a moment to write Gabby a quick message of support?**
[STAND AGAINST GOVERNMENT CENSORSHIP](http://links.newsletter.conservativedirect.com/s/c/zt8OiayVXStKLVLUZethyVkxGSxo2ehvPt9ql8ICt8HMCPyARA_SGWaAXexiVauDLEM03je0d_SukRAwNFjSpPVgdQhxuQnwFJDNCIMCwZ69fSWhd_C_oXJTu0ibxm8pAr3iUGRjlgzks8AbviilmEWohhnAZBZr8bQ8gvhSTkzXUjgXMasDROrSzt-qpkUMHzBpkmLYGyfgq30O_5Dy_2cJlPwXL3RNm3353SQRLWfb96uJcnVDKkItMVjcTIfWcYChVb50fIcFLvLtMfV0ZJYWS1LatCZE-tAf1FUxC54ZWgsRqE1wvxoKhW4cfFMME2PRIJhwjIqQZjbG0mj4QA6j398gUjMWYFBe2r_KY3jrJN_41-lwlXQiaqT1Lrk735QNWK2HGiIng-_owEKIXcdz0FLHA8XSgIgj9r_W7l6wRRO8qTwmFevNQaQSjbbYqIcEkoNmjR19xtAhq34f58F89KNbzCppxDX54OP4V3AktV8iPSx78KFRkXIYvX2nl6GJ0G_5PWXVGTd5kJQsoTjr52sSk2fc4H9FMMjU98kJoH0MmFGM_WsUmyfUrhVewzg1vizRgbnfqXv2lndS6AqmN9KDlHuLpfWbKFuZseEGnxIrR9qjTiWcfXazzxsodqLmvwjONBabTsFvHOjShrlJgJ2lCGYbZkjUA0NlL9A-9zs1ooifVmayDIyGoBczcGJlwVujE9x7UH-gpcmzdl710sjYCllO_9nS4zw2lcIHZJNeS_qbf7N4aTEiOyTORz407ob2THJokus/t2XokylbBJTlWuQGufnT-SYFH0KRGENm/17)

Charlie Kirk was a monumental figure to young Christians like Gabby--and none of them should have to suffer for wanting to honor his legacy.

Your support is appreciated!

For truth,

**Alliance Defending Freedom**

Law enforcement has been contacted and we are cooperating with the investigation." And now, imagine that message was aimed at YOU--because you got permission to paint your school's "spirit rock" with a message commemorating Charlie Kirk and the legacy he left to Christian youth. That's exactly what happened to Gabby Stout. She had expressly asked permission to paint the message--and the school had given it. But the next day, after she and her friends painted the rock with the messages "Freedom 1776" and "Live Like Kirk--John 11:25," school officials sent out a school-wide email accusing them of vandalism and launched a criminal investigation. And it got worse. The local news widely reported on the "vandalism" and "investigation"--and school officials hauled Gabby into an office and forced her to write a statement describing her actions and show them her phone logs. School officials never obtained permission from her parents to go through her phone, nor did they inform her or her parents of her constitutional right to remain silent and contact an attorney during a criminal investigation. The school punished Gabby--tried to silence her voice--yet officials had no problem supporting other student causes, including Black Lives Matter and protests against immigration enforcement. The hypocrisy couldn't be clearer. Of course, So the school quietly closed the investigation without an apology--and released a statement claiming they had never accused or investigated her at all. A few days later, the school unveiled a "Revised Spirit Rock Speech Code" that only allowed "positive school spirit" and messages that "uphold the inclusive values of our school community." It explicitly bans students from expressing religious or political messages on the spirit rock --and allows the school officials to subjectively decide which messages are "positive." The Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education, which targeted and unlawfully investigated Gabby, violated her First, Fourth, Fifth, and Fourteenth Amendment rights. Alliance Defending Freedom is suing the Charlotte-Mecklenburg Board of Education to make sure it will answer for its blatantly unconstitutional actions--punishing students for their views. body:
A new session, same defiance: How Colorado’s immigration policy put ideology over enforcement
| | | | [](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s3n20f22c23)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s3s03b33fe5)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s0u51739627), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s9je886e644) or [Rumble](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s3sf59ef3a3). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Denver has spent billions on homelessness, yet data show drug use and crime—not housing costs—are [driving chronic homelessness](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s4n0ef7677d). State officials are investigating an [incident involving Tina Peters](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s7k9dae6c84) at La Vista prison. Boulder businesses [suffered major losses](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s8p8dbe9d7c) after Xcel’s wildfire power shutoffs, while air regulators proposed permit [fee hikes of up to 70 percent](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sds724d7cf2). Gov. Jared Polis also insisted police can still work with the DEA [despite sanctuary laws](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s1qe53f00d6), even as critics say those policies continue to hinder enforcement and reflect an immigration approach driven more by [ideology than enforcement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s5o96fda9c7).
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The Supreme Court was asked to decide whether public schools can [punish teachers for off-duty speech](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sfmf13536f9), a case that could weaken First Amendment protections for millions of public employees. Meanwhile, federal officials [unveiled Colorado River management options](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s6t0b4ae98b) after states failed to reach agreement, signaling Washington may impose top-down water decisions affecting the entire West.
**🗣️ Commentary Spotlight...** Today's commentary argues conservatives are speaking more plainly not from extremism, but from clarity [after years of distortion](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s5v4b98eb1f). The author contends restraint enabled harmful policies on crime, immigration, education, speech, and medicine for minors, and that speaking clearly is now necessary to protect children, uphold free speech, restore law and order, and defend the family.
This is your Mountain Minute for Wednesday, January 21, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[A new session, same defiance: How Colorado’s immigration policy put ideology over enforcement](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/scn54648aca)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s9t00d0cd79)
[](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s7tfe769ba4)
Colorado lawmakers are walking into the 2026 session with the budget already tight. They’re also bracing for more legal fights with Washington.
New bills tied to ICE enforcement are moving early, including one that would expand the state’s ability to sue over immigration-related rights claims.
That push comes as Colorado is already in federal court over immigration laws passed last session. In Senate Appropriations on April 11, Sen. Barb Kirkmeyer zeroed in on SB25-276‘s price tag, asking whether its costs would come out of the legislature’s roughly $7.5 million set-aside for new mandates and litigation risks. The answer was a quick “Yes”—no hesitation, no alternative funding source offered.
Democrats introduced Senate Bill 25-276 wrapped in emotion. There were tears. Poetry. Stories about immigrant grandparents fleeing hardship. What emerged after party-line votes was something else entirely. The bill no longer resembled the narrow “civil rights tweak” sponsors had promised.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s2h360c8bd4)**
|
---
**[Homelessness Isn’t Just About Rent: Denver’s Spending Tells a Bigger Story](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sfr562bdd6c)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/seubead9fb1)
* **Billions spent, little progress:** Denver and the metro area have spent more than $1.9 billion on homelessness programs in recent years, including crossing $500 million in a single year, yet the city still ranks near the top nationally for total, chronic, and unsheltered homelessness.
* **Drugs and crime matter more than rent:** Data from the Common Sense Institute shows homelessness correlates more strongly with illicit drug use, crime, labor participation, and policing levels than with housing affordability alone, directly challenging the “housing-first” narrative.
* **Low enforcement, high spending states struggle most:** The analysis finds homelessness is highest in wealthy, high-spending states with widespread drug use and fewer police per capita, suggesting permissive policies and weak enforcement are driving chronic homelessness despite massive taxpayer investment.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s5n782188e0)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s2s8c93e9b6)
|
---
**[From Misunderstanding to Malice. Why Conservatives Finally Speak Plainly](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s2ndb032c3f)** BY C. J. GARBO, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s6s19f3ae5c)
* **Silence enabled distortion:** The commentary argues conservatives mistakenly treated bad-faith attacks as misunderstandings, allowing activists to weaponize moral accusations and dominate public debate while conservative voices withdrew out of fear of being mislabeled.
* **Real-world harm forced clarity:** The author points to measurable outcomes—from open-border policies and crime to censorship, parental displacement, and irreversible medical interventions for minors—as evidence that restraint became complicity rather than virtue.
* **Speaking plainly is moral responsibility:** Rejecting claims of “radicalization,” the piece says clear speech is a return to truth and accountability, grounded in protecting children, defending free speech, enforcing the law, and preserving the family as a foundational institution.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sdt0a81b97e)**
|
---

[**SB26-005: Colorado Bill Opens State Suits for ICE-Related Rights Violations—Even Against Private Actors**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s2l81caeda2)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s7p73c4951e)**BY SHAINA COLE | STATE | JANUARY 19** _Colorado lawmakers have introduced Senate Bill 26-005—legislation that would allow lawsuits in state court when an individual claims their rights under federal law have been violated as a result of civil immigration law enforcement._
__
[**Colorado’s prisons are on the verge of total collapse.**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s6qc6d72e3d)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sfm8eb21df6)**BY AHNAF KALAM | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 19** _Colorado’s prisons are on the verge of total collapse. As of late 2025, state facilities are operating at nearly 98% capacity, while being severely understaffed. Men’s prisons alone are projected to run out of beds entirely in the next fiscal year unless drastic measures are taken to reduce the population or add capacity._
__
[**Beyond the baby bust: Parents quietly exit Colorado public schools**](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/s8q23c897dc)
[****](https://link.email.rockymountainvoice.-fg/sfob85e6bed)**BY CHRISTIAN HORSTMANN | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 19** _Colorado’s public schools just posted their steepest enrollment slide since the pandemic: down more than 10,000 students this year, affecting each of our top ten largest districts and many others statewide.1 Denver Public Schools alone lost about 1,200 students2 and the district is already projecting another 6,000 by 20293 – almost certain to trigger even more school closures on top of the ten that have already been shuttered over the last few years._
__

Please, make your voice heard before it's too late.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769143/596505299/623074613?code=jtk1433-su-nd1&refcode=jtk1433-su-nd1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM3OTQiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiODIzNmYwMzEtMGNmNy1mMDExLThkNGMtMDAyMjQ4MmQyNzliIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=-OzsmBKePBqVGmDt3MWHIdNUF5KKUjalUY1HQwh-HeQ=&emci=67f1ac4c-43f6-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=8236f031-0cf7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=9329426)

Friend, foreign policy demands judgment, discipline, and a clear plan. **But Donald Trump recently described his approach this way: "My own morality. My own mind. It's the only thing that can stop me."**
That isn't leadership. It's recklessness.
The President of the United States commands extraordinary power – power that affects our national security, our alliances, and America's credibility for decades to come. That power must be guided by principles and strategy, not personal whims.
**Yet again and again, Donald Trump has shown that _he has no plan._**
In Venezuela, he authorized military action without coming to Congress – ignoring the Constitution – and offered no clear strategy for stability or peace. There was no endgame, no exit strategy, and no plan for what happens after, just chaos, danger, and the risk of another endless war – seemingly driven by oil interests and personal vendettas rather than American security.
Then Greenland. Threats against a NATO ally. Undermining the most successful military alliance in history. Sacrificing decades of trust and cooperation in pursuit of a warped sense of manifest destiny and personal acquisitiveness.
**Our allies are watching. And they are asking a dangerous question: Can America still be trusted?**
The damage doesn't disappear when Donald Trump eventually leaves office. Broken alliances take years, even generations, to repair. When America abandons principled leadership, our adversaries rush to fill the void.
**I believe America must lead with clarity, respect for international law, and a strategy worthy of our values – not impulse, intimidation, or ego. That's why I'm asking for you to take action today.**

the United States 7-2 decision in favor of granting standing in a
historic case filed on behalf of Congressman Mike Bost and two
presidential electors, who were before the court to vindicate their
standing to challenge an Illinois law allowing the counting of ballots
received up to 14 days after Election Day

body:
Detroit deserves a leader who's lived through the same struggles as his neighbors.

| [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769847/596507951/1328794144?refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=&emci=218df241-e8f6-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&emdi=e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ceid=4823105)
---
Detroit has been let down by its leaders for far too long. Career politicians and millionaires who show up every election cycle, make promises, then disappear to Washington and do nothing while families in Detroit struggle with pollution and corporate greed. **But Donavan McKinney refuses to let his home be sacrificed for corporate profits.** **[JanePAC endorsed McKinney in 2022 and 2024, and now we’re proud to re-endorse his run for Congress to represent Michigan’s 13th district in Washington. Will you chip in any amount you can afford today to help send Donavan to Capitol Hill?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769848/596507952/753063973?refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=)** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769849/596507953/753063973?refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=) Donavan isn't pretending to understand what Detroit needs. He’s lived through the same struggles as his neighbors. He grew up breathing air poisoned by smokestacks and watching DTE rake in record profits while his community struggled to afford their utility bills. His grandmother has an asthmatic cough. His mother has it. His brother has it. Donavan has it, too — the one that's far too common for anyone who grew up in the shadow of Detroit's factories. And he's done watching another generation inherit it. When Donavan got to the state legislature, he didn't waste time. He secured $600 million to replace lead pipes. Passed legislation protecting the Great Lakes. Sponsored a Ratepayer Bill of Rights to hold DTE accountable for gouging families. Even fought to ban utility monopolies from buying politicians with campaign cash. Now he's ready to bring that fight to Congress — to pass the Green New Deal, hold fossil fuel companies accountable, and stand up to corporate polluters who've treated Detroit like a sacrifice zone for generations. **And the stakes couldn’t be higher. This November, voters will decide whether we flip the House blue and finally put a check on Trump's authoritarian agenda — or whether he gets two more years to gut environmental protections and hand more power to his fossil fuel cronies.** **[Every seat matters. And the only way we win this one is the same way we've always won: people power. Grassroots supporters like you — chipping in what you can, when you can — are how we beat Big Oil's millions and send real fighters like Donavan to Congress. Can I count on you today?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769850/596507954/753063973?refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=)** _If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [**DONATE $5**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769851/596507955/753063973?express_lane=true&amount=5&refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=) | [**DONATE $25**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/123769852/596507956/753063973?express_lane=true&amount=25&refcode=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&ms=ea.e6ac27c1-0df7-f011-8d4c-0022482d279b&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9FQS9FQTAxNi8xLzk2NzgyIiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogImU2YWMyN2MxLTBkZjctZjAxMS04ZDRjLTAwMjI0ODJkMjc5YiIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=1ycDeKlmuYeBFIvC5t3TtWTwGb-SCpBD_Y9e5eM76Xo=)

clean_body: Detroit deserves a leader who's lived through the same struggles as his neighbors. | Detroit has been let down by its leaders for far too long. Career politicians and millionaires who show up every election cycle, make promises, then disappear to Washington and do nothing while families in Detroit struggle with pollution and corporate greed. But Donavan McKinney refuses to let his home be sacrificed for corporate profits. = = Donavan isn't pretending to understand what Detroit needs. He’s lived through the same struggles as his neighbors. He grew up breathing air poisoned by smokestacks and watching DTE rake in record profits while his community struggled to afford their utility bills. His grandmother has an asthmatic cough. His mother has it. His brother has it. Donavan has it, too — the one that's far too common for anyone who grew up in the shadow of Detroit's factories. And he's done watching another generation inherit it. When Donavan got to the state legislature, he didn't waste time. He secured $600 million to replace lead pipes. Passed legislation protecting the Great Lakes. Sponsored a Ratepayer Bill of Rights to hold DTE accountable for gouging families. Even fought to ban utility monopolies from buying politicians with campaign cash. Now he's ready to bring that fight to Congress — to pass the Green New Deal, hold fossil fuel companies accountable, and stand up to corporate polluters who've treated Detroit like a sacrifice zone for generations. And the stakes couldn’t be higher. This November, voters will decide whether we flip the House blue and finally put a check on Trump's authoritarian agenda — or whether he gets two more years to gut environmental protections and hand more power to his fossil fuel cronies. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = | = ---|--- = | = = | = In solidarity, Jane Fonda = | Follow along: | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- Paid for by Jane Fonda Climate PAC, not authorized by any candidate or candidate’s committee. body:
Peter,

Several weeks ago, myself and five other Members of Congress with service
and veteran backgrounds made a video directly quoting the Uniform Code of
Military Justice about the military’s responsibility to reject illegal
orders.

In response, President Trump called for my arrest, trial and death by
hanging.

Just recently, I learned that former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, U.S.
Attorney for the District of Columbia, asked to interview me.

This is on top of the FBI’s Counterterrorism Division’s inquiry at the end
of last year.

As a former CIA officer, I've seen democracies flicker out. I’ve seen what
life is like when a government is rigged. I’ve studied this kind of
political authoritarianism in other countries where you can't criticize
the guys in charge without getting a knock at the door in the middle of
the night.

It’s hard to believe I am talking about it in my own country, and the
knock is happening on my door.

I've always tried to be straight with you in these emails. When these
threats happen, it requires a strategy -- because no American wants to
live in a country where the president can weaponize the government against
his perceived enemies.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/39809?t=1007&amount=25&akid=3433%2E52803%2Ex27PWI ]So please: split a contribution between Senator Angela Alsobrooks and
my campaign today will help defend me from these attacks and allow me to

name: John Fetterman
subject: halfway through – here’s what I’ve been fighting for
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fetterman for PA
body:
[ https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/51612?refcode=jtk457-su-fl-header&t=1001&akid=10550%2E434096%2EzVDvw7 ]John Fetterman

Hey Derek – John here.

I’ve officially served half my term as your U.S. Senator, so I wanted to zoom out and check in. If you're short on time, will you click here to take my Mid-Term Survey right away?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/52645?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=1002&akid=10550%2E434096%2EzVDvw7

If you have a moment, here's what I've been focused on during the first half of my term as your U.S. Senator:

1. Standing up for workers and unions 💪

I’ve fought to expand collective bargaining for VA nurses and front line health workers, pushed to end sub-minimum wages for workers with disabilities, and backed bills to restore workplace protections for federal employees.

Workers deserve a voice in the workplace, dignity, and a fair shot.

2. Putting money back in people’s pockets 💵

I helped introduce legislation to protect and boost Social Security, co-sponsored the Price Gouging Prevention Act to stop corporations from jacking up prices, and helped reintroduce the Billionaires Income Tax Act so the ultra-rich finally pay their fair share.

CEOs don't need another yacht – working families should be able to pay their bills each month.

3. Fighting for a government that works for the people 🏛️

I voted against unqualified cabinet nominees, defended access to reproductive health care, stood up for LGBTQ+ rights, and introduced a bill to improve mental health care nationwide.

Because folks deserve someone who's looking out for them in Washington, D.C.

Now I want to hear from you. Will you take two minutes to fill out my Mid-Term Survey and tell me what's top of mind for you in the months and years ahead?

https://act.johnfetterman.com/go/52646?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&t=1003&akid=10550%2E434096%2EzVDvw7

Thanks, yinz. It’s an honor to serve as your Senator. 🇺🇸

John ❤️

# [One year of Donald Trump](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=185341864&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTg1MzQxODY0LCJpYXQiOjE3NjkwMzI5NDQsImV4cCI6MTc3MTYyNDk0NCwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.o2WSrzGOFdTY-Ye6y1c7Oyu7yDOVjl6TOd8AUcLVRpQ)
### Why I'm still feeling hopeful about the future.
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jan 21
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..xzsBvucinxlBrXpLqX7g-XoNeRK_aWfFSRVOJ7usQYo?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/one-year-of-donald-trump?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
It's official. Donald Trump has been back in office for one year, and if you're feeling angry, frustrated, or fed up with his nonsense, I understand. I am, too.
**One thing I 'm **_**not**_**feeling though is hopeless. Instead, I 'm feeling fired up, motivated, and more hopeFUL than ever.**
Because I've got tens of thousands of people like _you_ on my team. Thanks to you, a new poll shows our race for U.S. Senate here in Michigan is tied. But I'm not planning on staying tied - I'm planning to _win_.
**Together, we 're going to keep Michigan blue, take back the Senate for Democrats this November, and stop Donald Trump in his tracks.**
I'm not saying it's going to be easy, and I know the last year has been tough for so many of us. It's no secret Donald Trump's cruel policies and reckless agenda have hurt families and communities in Michigan and every corner of the country.
Let's review:
* 📉 He gutted Medicaid and cut health insurance subsidies.
* 🧪 He installed RFK Jr., a dangerous conspiracy theorist, as HHS secretary.
* 💸 He enacted reckless tariffs that raised prices and cost families an average of more than $1,600 in 2025.
* ❌ He deployed the military in U.S. cities.
* 🥶 And he's done _nothing_ to lower costs for working people - here in Michigan or anywhere else. In fact, he said last year he "couldn't care less" if auto prices go up.

Last year, I defended science, fought to lower costs, and delivered real results for Michigan families, including**over $13 million** returned to Michiganders in my district. At the start of my career, I helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs during President Obama's auto rescue. And since then, I've spent my career fighting for the good people who keep this state running.
As we kick off the second year of this administration, Donald Trump is hell-bent on maintaining his MAGA cronies' control of the Senate so he can keep doing whatever the heck he wants with ZERO pushback or consequences. After his visit to Detroit last week, he made it clear he's already laser-focused on our race.
But - and this is important - _we have the power to stop him._ It starts by keeping Michigan blue, and it's going to take ALL of us to do it.
Michigan's Senate race is as mission critical as it gets, and that's why it's a **top target** for the GOP.
_The Cook Political Report_ ranks it a **Toss Up**.**** Analysts at _The Hill_ say we're one of the **most likely to flip red** , so now Trump's megadonor friends, including a Texas oil billionaire, are spending **millions** to buy this seat for MAGA Mike Rogers.
But the good news is that poll after poll shows I'm the strongest Democrat to beat Rogers - and as I mentioned, the latest one shows us TIED. Our race is neck and neck - so we're hustling.
**Because if we win this seat, we can flip the Senate, make Trump a lame duck president for the rest of his term, and STOP the worst of his MAGA agenda from going into effect.**
Are you in? Because I promise you, that future is within reach. But I've said it before, and I'll say it again: This campaign isn't about me. It's about _us_.
And going up against millions in outside spending from the MAGA machine, I need this grassroots team's support, today, tomorrow, and every step of the way, to make a brighter future our reality.
If you're ready to help, I'd truly appreciate any amount you can **[chip in today](https://substack.com/redirect/25b65bbe-8de6-4819-816d-983d12c2698b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** to fuel this campaign.
[Donate](https://substack.com/redirect/25b65bbe-8de6-4819-816d-983d12c2698b?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm hopeful for everything we can accomplish together, and I'm ready to put in the work for my family and yours. I thank you for being by my side in this fight.
With grit, gratitude, hope, and determination,
Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

**Now, Trump is sending his political cronies at the Justice Department, including former Fox News host Jeanine Pirro, the U.S. Attorney for the District of Columbia, to try and threaten and intimidate me.**

I served three combat tours in Iraq and Afghanistan. I took an oath to defend the Constitution as a paratrooper, Army Ranger, and now Member of Congress. It’s a lifetime oath, and I intend to keep it.

Donald Trump has picked a fight with the wrong people. I refuse to be intimidated, and I won’t stand for our democracy to be dismantled. None of us want to live in an America where the President can weaponize the government against their perceived enemies.

body:
Hey Derek, it’s Mark.

We all remember what happened five years ago this month. Donald Trump sent
a mob to the Capitol to steal an election.
He had just lost an election, fair and square, and he didn’t like the
result. So he decided he was going to try to silence the voices of 81
million people.

It was one of the darkest days in the history of our country, but we made
it through.
Now he’s back, five years later, and it’s the same scheme. His Secretary
of Defense, Pete Hegseth, is trying to silence me as we speak. He thinks
he can make an example out of me, and intimidate others into staying
quiet.
But here’s the thing: Americans really like freedom of speech. You sign an
oath to defend it when you join the military. Trying to silence people
into compliance is just about the most un-American thing you can do.
Period.

There is nothing Trump or Hegseth or anybody in that administration can do
to shut me up. I am going to keep fighting for our people, our democracy,
and our Constitution.

We’re not going to let him win. Not a chance. So, five years on from
January 6th, I want you to take this to heart: Do not be afraid. Do not be
silent. Speak out.

We’re going to get through this the same way we did back then: together.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | First Invеstmеnt Updаtеs brоught tо уоu bу Іnception Media, LLC.
