Fellow Patriot

You'd think it would be common sense: if you're a dangerous criminal who isn't a U.S. citizen, you don't get to stay in this country.

But common sense is exactly what today's Democratic Party is fighting.

President Trump is enforcing the law-and the radical Left is losing its mind. Instead of standing with law-abiding Americans, they're flooding the streets to protest ICE.

**Radical Marxists and Islamist extremists depend on chaos. They want non-citizens to vote. They want open borders. And they want the rule of law erased.**

The men and women of ICE and our Border Patrol are doing the Lord's work—protecting our communities, enforcing the law, and standing in the gap while politicians in Washington look the other way.

If we're going to save this country, we must remove dangerous criminals and secure our elections.

That's exactly why I drafted the **SAVE Act** in 2024-to ensure that **only American citizens vote in American elections**. President Trump agrees: this must pass immediately.

The House passed it twice.

[CHECK OUT IBARRA'S LATEST WORK](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69601dc-42e3-414b-b545-9347ce8ccf38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
Mickey Ibarra had it made. After four years as Assistant to President Clinton--with a West Wing office and connections across America--he'd launched a successful lobbying firm in Washington.
But something felt wrong.
Thanks for reading! Subscribe for free to receive new posts and support my work.
[Pledge your support](https://substack..vQwAfrdDBCbZlNR7nj1h_tjer2ZSZjRQhFpyvCVljWI?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget-preamble&utm_content=185353004)
"I was losing my platform to advocate for my community and our leadership."
That realization changed everything. For 22 years now, Mickey has been on a mission: **preserve the Latino story before it 's lost.**
### **The Archive He is Building**
The Latino Leaders Network has hosted 77 leadership luncheons and 43 Tributes to Mayors--systematically documenting Latino achievement across politics, business, education, entertainment, and community organizing.
The requirement? Leaders must share their personal stories of obstacles overcome.
"I feel so strongly about the power of our stories, the inspiration, the motivation, and the importance of us sharing our stories," Mickey says.
Those keynote addresses are now compiled in his latest work: _**Latino Leaders Speak: Personal Stories of Struggle and Triumph, Volume II**_ , which you can find on [Arte Publico Press](https://link.sbstck.com/redirect/a69601dc-42e3-414b-b545-9347ce8ccf38?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--the nation's largest publisher of Latino authors.
### **Why It Matters**
Mickey himself didn't share his story publicly until he was already in the White House. He spent his first 15 years in foster care in Utah, struggling with identity, separated from his father--a Zapotec bracero from Oaxaca who was drafted into the Army while undocumented and later owned a Sacramento beauty salon.
But watching Bill Clinton's "The Man from Hope" video changed something. Mickey realized vulnerability inspires. Authenticity matters. Stories have power.
His own story appears in Volume Two, alongside leaders like Senator Alex Padilla, Arturo Vargas, and Maria Echaveste.
### **Beyond Individual Achievement**
The network celebrates more than traditional political success. The upcoming 43rd Tribute to Mayors honors Mayor Quinton Lucas of Kansas City--an African American mayor championing his Latino community.
"Every mayor in America is eligible," Mickey explains. "Our main criteria? Doing right by the Latino community."
It's about preserving the full story of Latino impact across all of American society.
### **The Work Continues**
Mickey is already thinking about Volume Three and succession planning.
"I will not live long enough to present the Eagle Leadership Award to everybody that deserves it. The Latino Leaders Network needs to be my lasting legacy. It needs to continue."
"We will never run out of powerful stories that need to be told. We have so many role models, so many heroes in our community."
His advice for the next generation echoes through both volumes:
**" Get inspired. Get prepared. And get ready to lead."**

Friend, **Tomorrow, the House of Representatives will vote on a set of appropriations bills to fund government agencies.** **One funding bill would give $65 billion to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which includes ICE and Border Patrol.** Our government seems to always find money for violence and war, but not a penny for our communities’ needs. Instead of adding more money to Trump’s racist deportation scheme, we should be spending taxpayer money on erasing medical debt or covering every American’s out-of-pocket prescription drug costs. [**Sign to demand Congress defund and abolish ICE. Instead of spending billions more taxpayer dollars for the Department of Homeland Security and ICE to kill more of our neighbors and violate our rights, our government should fund healthcare and other critical community needs.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9KvPvDcu7mzmlRlawE7HDHPwTE65o-C1b9Adzmk6Ylj3909-Y6983PaANC4kb-t4KnM5K3rhAhqASmfJO4Scih1kta5xmgRhBRIR3-5BVvzFT4PIAi0u6xZjrCWUNkRvoIk0TH4f8cEPQWcldmeuKCt5G73G7PdNOyNPyibHKgL0XNS7pUi1rdSsWOJY3Lkv5PFW6AcwnbsQviCEANUWoL20Xei3Yg6zDc9a362c5FnYBUGzUH5YOR8tAjiERFIxxFmhqJ1NLNifheeNjwDUSII3AbctuXkeiiqWSxyoHh4hHGpBnzulHxq5enzrZ_woZmYEJYxSeQ5btDByeWg9SVrOA8vj9wiJEnzM_naavo3x4MRv3Lc-wYV7J5ifVonnfqiILmr9mMve8R-GeuJVJgwGCH0Ks1LfX1xW5fJHCD2a2ILfehGfil7mt3HhSD44r_GRYi2YcdaYXW9Ouxpyahw/4nh/k_fyj3xcS7uQjUPBZVNtDA/h1/h001.hJ2MQQxsoty2P7yYmL0pqQq3yBbBUKaoySHws7vFwkg) | [ADD YOUR NAME](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9KvPvDcu7mzmlRlawE7HDHPwTE65o-C1b9Adzmk6Ylj3909-Y6983PaANC4kb-t4KnM5K3rhAhqASmfJO4Scih1kta5xmgRhBRIR3-5BVvzFT4PIAi0u6xZjrCWUNkRvojYJy-18h0yrdoHyzsPh-mNt-9X3UWyUF3fYwrfjYqr0VwEBYWUdslHjXSdOjs-21o0OLSJe4vY-Ln6BAn1kUBggOp8RrN1p0WydqUs_HspeYLf2IOEJ65kgxJ10Y1f9ymLzibIvFnfKaulpgCTiJvKStw-7zrD8311r9oB-yWn3H3W1KZP1TDBnwEk8yBTwN9NUy7eBjXHWO8t-OMn8LH5QxnWLaBi0eNOIxhOGGKenKKqqbQdKwM6CQHIqyLjy_mYrjYMnyZPjheOlExD8RKyMDY5pMdPcwQvGO1jtkEXJTjIbBKERcQx6b8dgs1VEE7YGcjuXPyj8-smdYB0X6Ow/4nh/k_fyj3xcS7uQjUPBZVNtDA/h2/h001.lWJQ24aaCPNU8laiHhjogF1L2XOCYV91uIgeddGKNHE)

Last week I went to Minnesota to witness and speak up against how ICE is terrorizing our communities.
After killing Renee Good, lawless ICE agents with tanks and big guns have been **storming into U.S. citizens’ homes, blowing up front doors** and grabbing people. They’re detaining Native Americans and senior U.S. citizens who are underdressed for the freezing cold.
They’re using tear gas and other dangerous and potentially fatal chemicals, **hospitalizing bystanders,** including babies. They’re**racially profiling** Black and Brown residents and kidnapping people off the street, leaving cars idling and dogs abandoned.
They continually **rip apart families** , including deporting young students from my district. They’re holding Americans of various immigration statuses in **horrific conditions**. We just learned about an ICE officer who raped a woman in detention for months as a condition for seeing her daughter. We know ICE has forcibly sterilized women in detention centers.
**Since ICE began in 2003, our immigrant neighbors have been sounding the alarm about how ICE abuses our rights, but the funding has continued to increase.**
Last year hit a record, with $170 billion taxpayer dollars going to DHS; $85 billion went to ICE.
Last year was ICE’s deadliest year in decades, and ICE nearly doubled the number of people in detention. Despite the unprecedented increase in funding, ICE illegally stopped paying for detainees’ necessary medical care. **In just the last three weeks, at least 5 immigrants have died while in ICE custody!**
**We must defend the lives and constitutional rights of all who call this country home**.
As the Republican House Speaker said last week,**ICE is doing what it’s designed to do.** We cannot reform ICE. We must defund and abolish it.
[**Please sign now to demand Congress vote NO on any bill that would give even more taxpayer money to the Department of Homeland Security and ICE. Instead of expanding ICE’s ability to kidnap and kill our neighbors, Congress must defund ICE and invest those billions of taxpayer dollars into life-saving needs such as healthcare.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm38h9nrsCCiMen3CGd5zila9KvPvDcu7mzmlRlawE7HDHPwTE65o-C1b9Adzmk6Ylj3909-Y6983PaANC4kb-t4KnM5K3rhAhqASmfJO4Scih1kta5xmgRhBRIR3-5BVvzFT4PIAi0u6xZjrCWUNkRvo8gC1qhF3mrdj4oshDa_btDCFX2zTuA-3ISOKWxVoUbF_bCiW95SsLy8fpZmIdRsbWSuaTQqmeggwn_L60khS5a3c8_dgqK-_0B_6JxKX9AU_40yxHykDqZWfjXow5Vn_umshOgORXHjHlSXw-qmZZkziRKZdfxMm1XJCvM9cmtXzGlO1AFfOhk5DsTORnTdBhucwYOBugxmfGw5iDMtOXdtYzRAKASUsRfD0iL-lUeBMCkDBZmjPPFsyG0XfkE4_iQEjGF_yboKmwhp3Y0Jz0sJgRe933CQhYAH5DxLS225tFKOi_S_0vET170xwW7ux4Vazgs5yHB-gtLs_GX3LyQ/4nh/k_fyj3xcS7uQjUPBZVNtDA/h3/h001.lMFY8vxtj4oA0unRNMfz8ZTbF3geLScG1xXiUDTSqmQ)

For the first time, more Americans want to abolish ICE than keep the agency. Already this month, people have come out to thousands of anti-ICE protests across the country. And every day, we see videos of people forcing ICE agents to leave their neighborhoods and successfully rescuing their neighbors from ICE agents’ attempted kidnappings.
I promise to keep standing with the people and defending our communities from state violence.
During Trump’s first administration, I passed amendments to block DHS from collecting detainees’ DNA and to defund programs that sent federal agents to U.S. cities. I’ve introduced bills to protect immigrant families, called on the UN to investigate the Department of Homeland Security, visited detention centers and held hearings to shine a light on their abuses, and raised funds for immigrant-led groups.
I will keep doing all I can, including holding Know Your Rights workshops and events to keep our communities safe and help people attain U.S. citizenship.
**My team and I have also compiled resources to help defend your immigrant neighbors and loved ones**[**here**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.X6XUC7u8ppFLNtMO_55SZlNseb7gEYIOhm_EWnhzEOaAWJjaFT1k7jow2SW7-_0md1tDg71hAkHyAdDaJzMAh_fP0z84BUL8_Wguoc1plDifbtTsHgUAb1nAvpEBRZzrNgRUX6iBOAs52s3kOHQZ0dW-sI_GgUse4M2_3Cb8tnx3u-Nh-mtyu4DKwc-20XudIBP7XhbNvorCx5enjiL6-lnCpn3RKYZtUiBuwp2LEQxvIRuN1Q6dzzvPfcR7ZZBetczjXyIDlSfAgc9laD_j60iV3mkHVUqrDcbskr8SaIEFTlTJKWvE4nxeO7YBtWdnRr1Yq5M8b1eeOhDLCbvKjG_w0vN3YvEhGjCrXTg2U_XrDCRI4rKy6yzjwfbFHAn8mPP3N6VHumqt3SKc1gsepHa2MBDK-Z7S9EkNpIIPu8hQ_0UXoGGzLPC6VHJfomAOi8hx3bly5MWNoOcXI-TD3EZB1dcyiFVqlYATRQopf4o/4nh/k_fyj3xcS7uQjUPBZVNtDA/h5/h001.W_QuTU6EiTWFTqtCtrl0ve_CWsE7IVdelcULXHUHW2g)**.**

Rashida

clean_body: The House votes TOMORROW on funding for ICE and other agencies. | | | Friend, Tomorrow, the House of Representatives will vote on a set of appropriations bills to fund government agencies. One funding bill would give $65 billion to the Department of Homeland Security (DHS), which includes ICE and Border Patrol. Our government seems to always find money for violence and war, but not a penny for our communities’ needs. Instead of adding more money to Trump’s racist deportation scheme, we should be spending taxpayer money on erasing medical debt or covering every American’s out-of-pocket prescription drug costs. | Last week I went to Minnesota to witness and speak up against how ICE is terrorizing our communities. After killing Renee Good, lawless ICE agents with tanks and big guns have been storming into U.S. citizens’ homes, blowing up front doors and grabbing people. They’re detaining Native Americans and senior U.S. citizens who are underdressed for the freezing cold. They’re using tear gas and other dangerous and potentially fatal chemicals, hospitalizing bystanders, including babies. They’reracially profiling Black and Brown residents and kidnapping people off the street, leaving cars idling and dogs abandoned. They continually rip apart families , including deporting young students from my district. They’re holding Americans of various immigration statuses in horrific conditions. We just learned about an ICE officer who raped a woman in detention for months as a condition for seeing her daughter. We know ICE has forcibly sterilized women in detention centers. Since ICE began in 2003, our immigrant neighbors have been sounding the alarm about how ICE abuses our rights, but the funding has continued to increase. Last year hit a record, with $170 billion taxpayer dollars going to DHS; $85 billion went to ICE. Last year was ICE’s deadliest year in decades, and ICE nearly doubled the number of people in detention. Despite the unprecedented increase in funding, ICE illegally stopped paying for detainees’ necessary medical care. In just the last three weeks, at least 5 immigrants have died while in ICE custody! We must defend the lives and constitutional rights of all who call this country home. As the Republican House Speaker said last week,ICE is doing what it’s designed to do. We cannot reform ICE. We must defund and abolish it. For the first time, more Americans want to abolish ICE than keep the agency. Already this month, people have come out to thousands of anti-ICE protests across the country. And every day, we see videos of people forcing ICE agents to leave their neighborhoods and successfully rescuing their neighbors from ICE agents’ attempted kidnappings. I promise to keep standing with the people and defending our communities from state violence. During Trump’s first administration, I passed amendments to block DHS from collecting detainees’ DNA and to defund programs that sent federal agents to U.S. cities. I’ve introduced bills to protect immigrant families, called on the UN to investigate the Department of Homeland Security, visited detention centers and held hearings to shine a light on their abuses, and raised funds for immigrant-led groups. I will keep doing all I can, including holding Know Your Rights workshops and events to keep our communities safe and help people attain U.S. citizenship. My team and I have also compiled resources to help defend your immigrant neighbors and loved ones. In love and solidarity, Rashida Rashida Tlaib for Congress PO Box 32777 Detroit, MI 48232 | Paid for by Rashida Tlaib for Congress | | Sent via . And I 've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I 'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I 'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... - STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. # Newsom mocks Trump's Davos speech, White House makes him regret it FAST!
California Gov. **[Gavin Newsom taunted President Trump's Davos speech](https://substack.com/redirect/175dbf4a-dd66-483a-abaf-43aca4d6e264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** as "boring" and "insignificant," declaring the Greenland invasion threat "never real," while the White House fired back by mocking him for watching from the "cuck chair" as Trump backed off military force but insisted on U.S. control.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/175dbf4a-dd66-483a-abaf-43aca4d6e264?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/cd4fc61a-1c20-41d2-a499-a6759101aa3d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **TACO Traders celebrate** **retreat** : Wall Street and Japanese investors cheered Trump's de-escalation on Greenland with "Trump Always Chickens Out" memes, driving stock rebounds after initial dips from tariff threats.

# Woke insurers screw taxpayers while championing DEI agenda: report
Major U.S. health insurers like UnitedHealth, CVS, and Elevance **[boasted perfect scores on LGBTQ inclusion](https://substack.com/redirect/d681b5f0-d332-45ed-bc54-81a9a6e2f0a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and DEI initiatives in 2025, even as they faced massive fraud probes, multimillion-dollar settlements, and accusations of over-billing federal programs--contributing to family premiums surging 26% to nearly $27,000 annually while patients endure rising denials and costs.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/d681b5f0-d332-45ed-bc54-81a9a6e2f0a0?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

* **DEI Glory Amid Probes** Major insurers earned top Human Rights Campaign ratings for transgender coverage and equity programs while UnitedHealth faced DOJ fraud investigations over Medicare Advantage billing manipulation.
* **Massive Penalty Payouts** CVS settled for $37 million on insulin over-dispensing claims and paid nearly $949 million for false government prescriptions, highlighting repeated taxpayer-funded overcharges.
* **Kickbacks and Consumer Pain** Elevance allegedly funneled over $230 million in illegal broker incentives to steer Medicare enrollees, as premiums climbed and claim denials rose across the industry.

# **Mamdani 's Democratic Socialists divided over Communist Chinese ties**
The Democratic Socialists of America--of which NYC Mayor Zohran Mamdani is a member--**[is divided over the group's connection to Chinese Communist Party officials](https://substack.com/redirect/39c24b1a-114a-4094-93bb-0453771f691f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** and efforts to silence criticism of China, with one member complaining "This isn't what I signed up for" after internal minutes obtained by Newsweek revealed "a sustained pattern of ideological alignment, narrative filtering, and network overlap" with Beijing.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/39c24b1a-114a-4094-93bb-0453771f691f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Meeting minutes show CCP contacts, trips to China since 2021:** Internal documents dating back to 2021 reveal DSA members openly discussing contacts with China's ruling party under the banner of "anti-imperialism" and repeated trips to meet with CCP officials, while participants urged others to avoid politically sensitive issues such as China's threats to invade Taiwan, the Hong Kong security crackdown, and abuses of the Uyghur Muslim minority.
* **Members pressured to self-censor on Chinese human rights:** One participant who raised concerns about the group ignoring Chinese rights said "Saying we can't talk about their rights until we defeat American imperialism doesn't work for me" but quickly apologized after being chastised by the group, with members who questioned the organization's stance on China deemed unkind and pushed toward conversations meant to foster debate.
* **DSA holds seminars praising China 's "strong democracy":** The report comes after The Post revealed DSA was holding monthly seminars about "modern China and lessons for US socialists," with one December session making wild claims about China's "strong democracy," claiming China has the largest economy on Earth, and insisting only state control of private businesses can save workers from "oligarchy," featuring speaker Ben Norton--an American studying Marxism in Beijing--who said "People just make up so much nonsense about China."

* * *
# **" Squad" Democrats join Republicans in vote to advance contempt resolutions against Clintons in Epstein probe**
The House Oversight Committee **[voted Wednesday to advance criminal contempt of Congress charges](https://substack.com/redirect/9f5044e3-d257-4426-9468-67022ddef0da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** against Bill and Hillary Clinton for defying subpoenas related to the Jeffrey Epstein probe, with the committee voting 34-8 to advance Bill Clinton's resolution (nine Democrats joining Republicans) and 28-15 for Hillary Clinton's (three Democrats joining Republicans), including "Squad" members Summer Lee and Rashida Tlaib who voted to advance both resolutions.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/9f5044e3-d257-4426-9468-67022ddef0da?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Clintons refused to appear for depositions despite rescheduling:** Bill and Hillary Clinton originally received subpoenas to appear on October 14 and October 9, 2025, respectively, but did not appear even after working with the committee to reschedule, with their attorney calling the subpoenas "invalid and legally unenforceable" and instead offering Chairman James Comer the opportunity to travel to New York for an informal interview without an official transcript, which Comer rejected as "insulting."
* **Democrats call effort partisan while acknowledging Clintons should comply:** Democrats at the markup called Republican efforts a partisan attack meant to target Trump's political adversaries, with Rep. Emily Randall saying it's not her "responsibility to carry out the political retribution of the current president," though Rep. Dave Min acknowledged "No one should be above the law, including presidents and former presidents" and said "I think the Clintons should be here. I think it's very shameful that they're not," as the House will likely consider the contempt resolutions in February.

This episode of _**Amped Up**_ featured a wide-ranging, deeply substantive conversation with [Bree Fram](https://open.substack.com/users/99299122-bree-fram?utm_source=mentions), a retired Air Force and Space Force colonel, a trailblazing transgender service member, and a newly announced candidate for Congress in Virginia. [Cliff Schecter](https://open.substack.com/users/31941177-cliff-schecter?utm_source=mentions) and [David Shuster](https://open.substack.com/users/16891317-david-shuster?utm_source=mentions) moved the discussion deliberately from personal service to national security to democratic renewal.
* * *
### **1\. A Life of Service -- and a Forced Exit**
* Col. Fram described her 23-year military career, including service in Iraq and senior leadership roles in Air Force Space Command and the Space Force.
* She explained how a Trump administration executive order led to the forced removal of transgender service members--despite spotless records and court findings that the policy was rooted in animus, not readiness.
* The cost, she emphasized, wasn't just personal--it was strategic: the loss of thousands of experienced, mission-ready personnel weakened U.S. national security.

| [](https://substack.com/redirect/c22b995a-c5af-4627-b569-9cf281e1877c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* * *
### **2\. The Reality Inside the Military**
* Fram powerfully countered right-wing myths about transgender service, describing overwhelming support from colleagues, commanders, generals, and admirals.
* She recounted moments of quiet solidarity--handshakes, words of respect, and shared grief--as her forced departure became real.
* The military, she argued, has often been ahead of civilian society on inclusion--and is now being dragged backward by political extremism.

* * *
### **3\. National Security, NATO, and the Trump Doctrine**
* The panel examined Trump's erratic foreign policy--from Greenland threats to tariffs--and how they've pushed allies into defensive postures against the United States itself.
* Fram dismantled the rationale behind Trump's claims that U.S. sovereignty over Greenland is necessary for missile defense, calling it strategically nonsensical and diplomatically destructive.
* She warned that this administration views power only through force and money--undermining decades of alliance-based security.

* * *
### **4\. Why Congress -- and Why Now**
* Fram framed her congressional run as a continuation of her oath to the Constitution, not a career pivot.
* She outlined the leadership skills she brings: managing billion-dollar programs, long-range security planning, and delivering results under pressure.
* With Virginia undergoing redistricting, she stressed the urgency of starting early to give voters a clear choice grounded in competence and values.
* Please find out more about Bree's campaign here: [https://teambree.com/](https://substack.com/redirect/c22b995a-c5af-4627-b569-9cf281e1877c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

* * *
### **5\. Democracy, Accountability, and Renewal**
* The conversation broadened to ICE abuses, executive overreach, and the erosion of constitutional norms.
* Fram supported accountability--from impeachment to structural reform--and argued for re-imagining institutions to restore public trust.
* Her closing message was steady and hopeful: democracy survives only if people engage, show up, and do the hard, sometimes boring work of self-government.

* * *
A serious, clarifying, and quietly inspiring hour--one that reminded listeners what principled leadership looks like, and why it still matters.

body:
ICE is covering up how many people are dying under their watch. We can expose them. | |
---
Peter, **Last year was ICE’s deadliest in decades.** Thirty people died in ICE custody. Unaccountable agents are running rampant in the streets, kidnapping people without cause, and harming protestors and immigrants alike. **The Trump administration has worked to cover up ICE’s activity and hide how many people they’re harming.** A 2022 Department of Justice report found that 200 preventable suicides occurred under the watch of our government officials. There are also reports of other deaths in ICE detention centers, even one that the medical examiner will likely list as a homicide.1 **Evading transparency, rather than acting on this report, is unacceptable.** [**Public health experts and advocates are fighting for transparency. Join them! The Centers for Disease Control (CDC) can and should be tracking these tragedies in our detention facilities. Add your name and demand the CDC add a checkbox for deaths in custody.**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.qUXRBnqZ7T8nxbpAcIVwoUsWLkUMWlo_0JmZttSlm3_CO0_MmOwgPv2jBa5FccqcE5GyjQ4B6bzIH2D2LmZRGAlj6k4J6HnVbavwxvxtPkR2cpXs7LhpdFccbwpy64MzUz5f6U0T_KK7dTvZOIfP-X9L79_udhFVJNSyb_Vakw-J6Jy9KDzjFQwbJ2kuxyWtDlZaTVtIon1re_kRNH-Dz2szBGU7nEXbo4ap0CymEajtfS5TF2-wM36o4Q1S6Wwz-4K-3ToM-i9AqNLQJujlwYly_qyZG8UIKY4L7GVYLaei5dCz7MdCWmKq16ruHMG7VCzjCK2mMo8Bweg6LZGsbszo7-F86AvtPEH8GQ5zgOzIwVL9qzTN9JRqaXpDQQwZFczuy0-BEClDj_nqB2xU2XeC9gflnyudyMx1F94zKdz6HcoIH-5LmhUDbORcTR0dFZFdj634gsZe3z3qvMagOLjp86ZEiWpuQXuSIX1-aGTsv5OfSdrJSdTUQn1eS5GC1jifRgmRbjXl1ALLKhAEAAnyvpURfykgzsQZ-bj4LWc/4nh/Vg9-yJA6SN2YjtKbijYPhQ/h0/h001.5ee-oW-x69y40rU_ibaRY9ReWSxJZnT7_oAqXPRnAhw) **We can’t respond to the harms ICE is wreaking on our communities without transparency.** That’s why witnesses are recording encounters, and news outlets are tracking violence and deaths. **But we need our democratic systems to look out for us, too.** Our justice system has underreported deaths in Black, Brown, and Indigenous communities for too long. This administration must begin amending death certificates to indicate whether someone died in custody. Nearly 3,000 armed masked ICE agents have been deployed to Minnesota. Working people are being detained on their way to work, school, or even the grocery store, violating the Constitutional and human rights of our neighbors. The fatal shooting of Renee Nicole Good at the hands of an immigration agent is a reminder of what we’ve known all along: ICE and CBP do not keep us safe. We, the people, keep one another safe. In a moment where we’re witnessing our communities being targeted, harassed, and torn apart, we’re uniting to demonstrate the collective economic power we hold when we stand together. 💪🧡 🗣️ send a clear message about our collective economic power: No school, no labor, no shopping until our communities can live in safety and dignity in the places we call home. This moment requires us to stand united, and your solidarity can take many forms. As Congress continues to pour billions of our taxpayer dollars into the Department of Homeland Security, many of us across the country are struggling to make ends meet. That’s why this nationwide strike is not only about pausing our daily economic activity but also about choosing community over death and destruction. This Friday, Minnesotans are calling on us to: Stay home from work and school 🏠 Refuse to shop or spend money in large corporations 💵 * Choose rest and community over businesses 🫂 Whether you’re striking for an hour, or inviting a friend to participate in the nationwide strike, your participation matters. In solidarity, Ximena and the UWD team | Follow us on: | | | | |

**I 'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. But what Tim Walz, the far-Left, and the career politicians have done to our state forced me to reconsider, including when they ... **
**- STORMED our churches to intimidate worshippers - SQUANDERED our tax dollars on fraudulent daycares- DEMONIZED our brave cops and border agents- ALLOWED men into women's locker rooms - TAXED us into oblivion with zero tangible benefits - SUED the Trump Admin to allow boys in girls' sports- OPENED our borders to millions of illegal immigrants- FORCED divisive propaganda into our classrooms**
**As a sports professional, patriot, Catholic, granddaughter of legal immigrants, wife, and mama bear, they've come after just about everything I care about most. So I had a choice to make: 1) let my state and country descend into ruin, or 2) take a leap of faith to fix it. **
**Experts and consultants told me running for Senate in Minnesota was a fool 's errand. **
**After all, we have a far-Left Governor and two far-Left Senators, Minnesota has been a blue state since Nixon, and it 's the ONLY STATE Ronald Reagan didn't win. **
**But blazing my own trail has never scared me. I made history on TV and won four Emmys for my sports coverage. I 've taken on longer odds than this - and I beat them. **

**Luckily, there are a lot more of us than there are of them! **

clean_body: Hi folks! I just made it official: I‘m running for U.S. Senate! - my name is Michele Tafoya. I made a career as a sideline reporter for some of the biggest moments in sports history. I spent many Sunday evenings out on the gridiron. And I 've interviewed all-time greats, including Peyton Manning, Patrick Mahomes, and many others who changed the game forever. Now I 'm ready to make a big change myself. With the disaster that failed leadership has brought us to in Minnesota, I just made it official: I'm running for U.S. Senate in my home state of Minnesota! Before I go on, this will be one of the most consequential Senate races in the entire country - is there anything I can say to convince you to become a to my new campaign? never in my life thought I'd be sending you this email. I 'm not a politician, I haven't run for office before, and elected office wasn't really an endgame I'd ever thought about. subject: Caucus for David: important updates + upcoming actions
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Seligman for AG,
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
Hi there,
Shane here, David’s field organizer. I wanted to share a quick update on what’s coming up for the campaign and how you can jump in right now. We’re building real momentum across Colorado, and every one of these moments matters as we organize to get David on the primary ballot and win this race.
VOLUNTEER PORTAL [https://sites.google.com/seligmanforag.com/seligman-volunteer-portal?usp=sharing]
Caucus for David
The campaign needs your help to get David on the primary ballot! Caucus with us! Any registered Democrat over 16 is eligible. Learn more and sign up to caucus here. [https://www.seligmanforag.com/caucus-for-david]
Volunteer Onboarding - Thursday 1/22
We are asking for all volunteers to attend a volunteer onboarding call at least once. On these biweekly calls, we share what's next for the campaign and how you can get involved in the plan to win. If you are feeling hyped to be part of the fight to transform Colorado politics and put the law on the side of working people, you won't want to miss this! Our next call is Thursday, January 22nd at 6:30 PM. RSVP here [https://www.mobilize.us/seligmanforattorneygeneral/event/887617/]
Meet and Greet with David Seligman - Saturday 1/24
Enjoy conversation and snacks with David Seligman and CO HD16 candidate Steph Vigil at the IvyWild School in Colorado Springs. RSVP here [https://www.eventbrite.com/e/1980873514004?aff=oddtdtcreator]
What has David been up to?
Marched at the MLK Marade
This past Monday, David, along with Julie Gonzales’s campaign for Senate, marched in the MLK Marade— honoring Dr. King’s legacy and recommitting to a movement that demands the law work for all of us, not just the wealthy and well-connected.

David with Javier Mabrey and Senator Julie Gonzales at the MLK Marade on Monday
ICE Centennial Office Protest
David is running for Colorado Attorney General to stand up for the people of Colorado—including holding ICE officers accountable when they break the law. The campaign was thankful to join so many others outside the ICE Denver Field Office on Sunday.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
David standing with community members at a recent ICE protest outside the ICE Denver Field Office.
Colorado Young Dems Caucus Training all day event
Thankful to our volunteers for spending the day at the Colorado Young Democrat Caucus Training on Saturday! More than half of the crowd had never gone to caucus before. It’s so exciting in our community and in our campaign to see so many Coloradans getting involved in our democratic processes!
Meeting with community groups - Heather Gardens Indivisible, Tuesday Democrats, Windsor Gardens
David had several opportunities to connect with local communities in the past week. Including folks with Heather Gardens Indivisible, Tuesday Democrats, and Windsor Gardens.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
David with the Tuesday Democrats talking about ICE accountability and federal vs. state law.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
David speaks at Windsor Gardens, discussing the power of the attorney general's office and how state law can work for Coloradans.
Supporting union workers
David and team stood alongside SEIU Local 105 and the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless Workers United at a bargaining table that guarantees workers basic workplace rights.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-26q1?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]

David and I at the Colorado Coalition for the Homeless Workers United protest alongside SEIU 105 to march in good faith bargaining for a fair contract.
Talking to working Coloradans
David doesn’t mince words–especially when it comes to politicians’ latest sloganeering around “affordability.” You should watch our latest campaign ad, and if you can, make a donation so we can elect an AG who will actually do something about the cost of living in Colorado. [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-affordability?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-affordability?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upl_dhs_email-affordability?refcode=x_260121_campaignnewsletter_act]
Latest campaign updates
On the campaign, we are getting out into communities across Colorado and organizing new folks to caucus for David every day! Our local organizer volunteers are currently planning over 10 volunteer-led events across the state. Join the Slack today and join your regional channel to stay up to date! [https://seligmanorganizing.slack.com/join/shared_invite/zt-3dzgrl4hh-MGkipryPXQM14kyBuvk0dQ]
Huge shoutout to volunteer Sunny in Pueblo for organizing a caucus training with the Pueblo Humanists this month!
We host virtual phone banks every Mon-Thurs 4-6pm. [https://www.mobilize.us/seligmanforattorneygeneral/event/866102/] If this time doesn’t work for you, you can make calls anyday, anytime 9am-9pm. Here is the link to the latest phone bank.
We also host numerous trainings and virtual events for our volunteers across the state to come together!
Volunteer Onboarding
* First Tuesday and third Thursday at 6:30 PM
Caucus 101
* First Wednesday at 6:30 PM
Monthly Volunteer Rallies
* First Sunday at 7:00 PM
Thanks so much for being part of this fight. Every call made, every caucus attended, every conversation had is helping build a people-powered campaign that can win. I’m excited to keep organizing alongside you.
In solidarity,
Shane
Field Organizer, Team David

Peter ,
Here’s a little-known news story that isn’t getting enough attention:
Right now, Republicans are asking the Supreme Court for their next major win: dismantling campaign finance laws.
In a case now before the Court, the GOP wants to eliminate limits on how closely party committees can coordinate spending with candidates – effectively allowing unlimited, coordinated money to flood House and Senate races nationwide. If they win, it would be the biggest rollback of campaign finance rules since Citizens United.
Republicans know they’re outmatched when turnout is high – so instead, they’re trying to tilt the system even further toward billionaires, mega-donors, and national party bosses. A ruling in their favor would let party committees operate like super PACs, consolidating power in the hands of a few wealthy interests.
Democrats are fighting back in court, but no Supreme Court decision will protect democracy on its own.
The real firewall is voters – especially in the most competitive districts where turnout can still overwhelm big money.
Your donation helps us turn out Democrats at scale in 2026, countering a system Republicans are actively trying to rig in their favor. Will you chip in right now to help us build the turnout operation democracy depends on? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gotvpac2026?refcode=Email1212026]
